note: THE BEST ARM IN THE ROUND ON EVERYTHING EXCEPT THE TIE-BREAKER, AND IT IS STILL CLOSED. It is the only capacity arm that improves TKE, MVPE and wfinal on both splits without losing rel-L2, and it does so through the MODE dimension, where 99.4 % of an FNO's parameters live -- the same axis --mode-drop touched from the other side in round 16. Reading the two together is the interesting part: DROPPING modes gave best-rel-L2 / TKE-cost / sps-flat, ADDING them gives best-TKE / rel-L2-flat / sps-flat. Both directions on one axis improve something real and neither moves sps. What kills it is arithmetic, not the measurement: at 2.49x the parameters it is ONE fp16 member instead of four, worth about -1.30 sps by round 8's ensemble curve, against +0.01/+0.04 measured. FOUR INDEPENDENT MECHANISMS NOW MOVE THE rel-L2 <-> TKE EXCHANGE AND NONE MOVES sps: capacity (this job: more layers, more width, more retained modes -- all buy TKE and pay rel-L2) against --phases 4 and round 16's --mode-drop (both buy rel-L2 and pay TKE). sps is flat in every case. That is a statement about the OPERATING POINT, not about any mechanism: at w96/L8/do45 sps sits at a stationary point of the rel-L2 <-> TKE trade and is not reachable through it. Round 15's board is why this matters -- T2R3 made rel_l2 0.64 % WORSE and gained +1.013 sps, so sps is what pays.
note_zh: 除了决胜项之外，它是本轮各方面最好的臂，但依然被关闭。它是唯一在两个划分上同时改善 TKE、MVPE 和 wfinal 且不损失 rel-L2 的容量臂，而且它是通过模态维度做到的——FNO 99.4 % 的参数就长在那里，也正是第 16 轮 --mode-drop 从另一侧触碰的同一条轴。把两者合起来读才是有意思的地方：丢弃模态给出的是「最好的 rel-L2 / 一份 TKE 代价 / sps 不动」，增加模态给出的是「最好的 TKE / rel-L2 持平 / sps 不动」。同一条轴的两个方向都改善了某个真实的东西，而两个方向都推不动 sps。真正杀死它的是算术，不是测量：在 2.49 倍参数下它只能装一个 fp16 成员而不是四个，按第 8 轮的集成曲线约值 -1.30 sps，而实测收益只有 +0.01/+0.04。如今已有四个互不相关的机制在推动 rel-L2 与 TKE 之间的交换，却没有一个能推动 sps：容量（本作业：更多层、更大宽度、更多保留模态——全都买到 TKE、赔上 rel-L2）对上 --phases 4 与第 16 轮的 --mode-drop（两者都买到 rel-L2、赔上 TKE）。每一次 sps 都纹丝不动。这说的是这个工作点的性质，而不是任一机制的性质：在 w96/L8/do45 上，sps 处在 rel-L2 与 TKE 交换的一个驻点上，无法通过这条交换抵达。第 15 轮的 board 是这件事之所以重要的原因——T2R3 让 rel_l2 差了 0.64 %，却拿到 +1.013 的 sps，所以真正买单的是 sps。

arm: the L8 interior-Re k-fold REFERENCE: kfre_w96L8do45_f0..4, paired against round 15's kfre_w96do30_f0..4
arm_zh: L8 的内插雷诺数 k 折参照：kfre_w96L8do45_f0..4，与第 15 轮的 kfre_w96do30_f0..4 配对
instrument: kfold.py --split re, 5 folds trained at the shipped control recipe (w96 / L8 / do45 / 400 ep / --var-mlp --lift-mlp / seed 1) with --exclude per fold; kfold.py --paired --alpha 0.60 on IDENTICAL windows so the trajectory effect cancels; decision number = interior bands 1-3 pooled (Re 8850-22875, 2152 windows / 52 trajectories); bands 0 and 4 reported and never decided on
instrument_zh: kfold.py --split re，5 折，全部用已发布的对照配方训练（w96 / L8 / do45 / 400 轮 / --var-mlp --lift-mlp / seed 1），每折带自己的 --exclude；kfold.py --paired --alpha 0.60 在完全相同的窗口上配对，使轨迹效应相消；决策数字 = 内插带 1-3 汇总（Re 8850-22875，2152 个窗口 / 52 条轨迹）；带 0 与带 4 只报告、绝不据以决策
effect: B (L8/do45) beats A (L4/do30) on EVERY metric, in EVERY interior fold, at EVERY angle of attack: rel-L2 -1.21 % at z = -8.16, TKE -1.47 % at z = -7.18, MVPE -0.83 %, sps 48.674 vs 48.366 (+0.308), wfinal 84.448 vs 84.323 (+0.125). Per fold rel-L2 -1.39 / -1.32 / -0.93 %, TKE -2.15 / -1.71 / -0.59 %. All five bands would read -3.24 % rel / -3.11 % TKE, but band 0 alone is -6.27 % / -7.31 % on 798 of 3383 windows
note: THE COMPARATOR OWED SINCE ROUND 16 NOW EXISTS, AND IT COMES WITH TWO CAVEATS THAT MATTER MORE THAN THE NUMBER. (1) IT IS NOT A READING OF DEPTH ALONE. The A side's stored config is n_layers 4, dropout 0.30; the B side is n_layers 8, dropout 0.45, so the pairing moves depth AND dropout together and no fold set exists that separates them. Round 16's screens say most of it is depth (L4 -> L8 at do45 was +0.18/+0.36 sps; do30 -> do45 at L8 was worth 0.00 sps) but this instrument cannot prove that split, and the plan's description of Q2d as 'the interior-Re reading of depth' overstates what was measured. (2) THE DIRECTION IS CERTAIN AND THE SIZE IS BELOW BOARD RESOLUTION. kfold.py's own printed rule is '|z| clears ~2 AND the % clears the board's ~2 % transfer resolution; the first is necessary, only the second is sufficient' -- z = -8.16 clears the first by a mile and -1.21 % fails the second. BAND 0 IS THE TRAP: quoting all five bands turns -1.2 % into -3.2 % purely on the strength of band 0, the regime round 14's board retired when the gated mean-blend fired on zero hidden windows. One corroboration worth keeping: the R16 -> R17 board step returned tke -1.2 % / -1.1 % on the two boards and this k-fold predicts -1.47 % for the same depth change per model, which agrees; rel-L2 does not agree, but that board step also halved the ensemble, so it is not the same experiment.
note_zh: 第 16 轮就欠下的那个对照物如今建成了，而它附带的两条限定比数字本身更重要。(1) 它不是对深度单独的测量。A 侧存下的配置是 n_layers 4、dropout 0.30，B 侧是 n_layers 8、dropout 0.45，所以这次配对同时动了深度和 dropout，而且不存在能把两者分开的折集。第 16 轮的筛选说其中大部分来自深度（在 do45 上 L4 -> L8 是 +0.18/+0.36 sps；在 L8 上 do30 -> do45 值 0.00 sps），但这个仪器无法证明这个拆分，计划里把 Q2d 称作「深度的内插雷诺数读数」是说过头了。(2) 方向是确定的，幅度却低于 board 的分辨率。kfold.py 自己打印的规则是「|z| 要过 ~2，并且百分比要过 board 约 2 % 的迁移分辨率；前者是必要的，只有后者才是充分的」——z = -8.16 远远过了第一条，而 -1.21 % 没过第二条。带 0 就是那个陷阱：把五个带全算上，会仅凭带 0 就把 -1.2 % 变成 -3.2 %，而那正是第 14 轮的 board 在带门控的均值混合于零个隐藏窗口上触发之后所退役的区间。有一条值得留下的旁证：R16 -> R17 的 board 步在两个榜上返回 tke -1.2 % / -1.1 %，而这次 k 折对同样的每模型深度变化预测 -1.47 %，两者吻合；rel-L2 并不吻合，但那一步同时把集成规模砍半，所以不是同一个实验。

arm: --sim + --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full --sim-exclude-held at w96 / L8 / do45: mapped-sim co-training, re-asked IN DISTRIBUTION and at capacity
arm_zh: 在 w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --sim + --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full --sim-exclude-held：映射后的仿真联合训练，在分布内、在容量下重问
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r16_w96_do45_L8; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; drop rule = beat the control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the seed floor (0.00 proxy / 0.05 full) without losing rel-L2; --exclude left at its default so train2.py passes VAL_TRAJ as real_exclude and the domain map is leak-free (26 of 100 sim conditions fall back to the fitted freestream law = 18 real never had + 8 held out; the cache tag x476193e300 was verified equal to sha1(sorted(VAL_TRAJ)))
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；淘汰规则 = 两个划分上的 sps 都要超过对照且幅度大于种子底噪（代理集 0.00 / 全划分 0.05），同时不能损失 rel-L2；--exclude 保持默认，于是 train2.py 把 VAL_TRAJ 作为 real_exclude 传下去，域映射因此无泄漏（100 个仿真条件中有 26 个回退到拟合的来流定律 = 真实数据本就没有的 18 个 + 留出的 8 个；缓存标签 x476193e300 已验证等于 sha1(sorted(VAL_TRAJ))）
effect: PASSES THE DROP RULE, the only arm of the round that does. sps 44.30 vs 43.97 proxy (+0.33, against a three-seed proxy range of 0.00) and 50.52 vs 50.40 full (+0.12, 2.4x the 0.05 floor). It improves ALL FOUR error metrics on BOTH splits: rel-L2 -1.41 % / -1.27 %, TKE -0.79 % / -0.57 %, MVPE -1.66 % / -1.27 %; wfinal +0.131 / +0.065. Training field 0.04026 (+4.9 %) with the sim term converging 2.89 -> 0.115, so the mapped sim windows were fitted rather than ignored
effect_zh: 通过淘汰规则，是本轮唯一做到的臂。代理集 sps 44.30 对 43.97（+0.33，而三种子的代理集极差是 0.00），全划分 50.52 对 50.40（+0.12，是 0.05 底噪的 2.4 倍）。它在两个划分上改善了全部四个误差指标：rel-L2 -1.41 % / -1.27 %，TKE -0.79 % / -0.57 %，MVPE -1.66 % / -1.27 %；wfinal +0.131 / +0.065。训练 field 0.04026（+4.9 %），sim 项从 2.89 收敛到 0.115，说明映射后的仿真窗口是被真正拟合了，而不是被忽略
note: THE FIRST TIME SIM HAS EARNED ANYTHING IN DISTRIBUTION, AND IT IS NOT YET A RESULT. Round 5 measured sim -> real at +0.00 without a domain map. Round 14 measured --sim-loss full at -22 % on relo -- and round 14's BOARD then retired relo, because the gated mean-blend fired on ZERO hidden windows, so sim's entire case lived in a regime the board does not contain. Both splits here sit inside the training Reynolds range, which is the board's actual situation, so this is the re-proof plan_20260905 §3 bet 2 demanded. It also DEPLOYS FREE: a --sim checkpoint is architecturally identical to a shipped member and fuses into the same single invocation, so unlike every Q2a capacity arm it costs no member and no latency. FOUR REASONS NOT TO BELIEVE IT YET: (1) one seed, and the full-split margin is only 2.4x the floor; (2) rel-L2 -1.3 % is BELOW the board's ~2-4 % transfer resolution, so it can be real and still unreadable on the board -- the trap Q2d documented the same day; (3) NOT ensemble-tested, and ROADMAP 1.15 says an arm measured at one model has not been measured -- essentially every candidate since round 10 has died at the 3-vs-3; (4) NOT k-fold confirmed against the kfre_w96L8do45 reference Q2d built this round. Q3 (seeds 2-3 + 3-vs-3) and Q4 (paired k-fold) are the next steps.
note_zh: 这是仿真第一次在分布内挣到东西，但它还不是一个结论。第 5 轮在没有域映射的情况下把 sim -> real 量成 +0.00。第 14 轮把 --sim-loss full 量成 relo 上的 -22 %——而第 14 轮的 board 随后退役了 relo，因为带门控的均值混合在零个隐藏窗口上触发，于是仿真的全部立论都待在一个 board 并不包含的区间里。这里的两个划分都落在训练雷诺数范围之内，也就是 board 的真实处境，所以这正是 plan_20260905 §3 第 2 个赌注所要求的重新证明。它还能免费部署：一个 --sim 检查点在架构上与已发布的成员完全相同，会融进同一次调用，所以不像 Q2a 的任何容量臂，它既不花成员也不花延迟。四条现在还不能相信它的理由：(1) 只有一个种子，而全划分的margin 只有底噪的 2.4 倍；(2) rel-L2 的 -1.3 % 低于 board 约 2-4 % 的迁移分辨率，所以它可以既真实又在 board 上读不出来——正是 Q2d 同一天记录下的那个陷阱；(3) 没有做集成测试，而 ROADMAP 1.15 说「在单个模型上量过的臂等于没量过」——自第 10 轮以来几乎每一个候选都死在 3 对 3 上；(4) 没有对 Q2d 本轮刚建好的 kfre_w96L8do45 参照做 k 折确认。Q3（种子 2-3 + 3 对 3）与 Q4（配对 k 折）是接下来的步骤。

arm: --dropout 0.60 at w96 / L8 (one notch past the shipped 0.45)
arm_zh: 在 w96 / L8 上的 --dropout 0.60（比已发布的 0.45 再上一档）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r16_w96_do45_L8; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; drop rule = beat the control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the seed floor (0.00 proxy / 0.05 full) without losing rel-L2
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；淘汰规则 = 两个划分上的 sps 都要超过对照且幅度大于种子底噪（代理集 0.00 / 全划分 0.05），同时不能损失 rel-L2
effect: sps +0.03 proxy / -0.14 full -- a SPLIT decision that fails the full-split half. rel-L2 improves on both (-0.66 % / -0.63 %) and TKE pays more than that back (+1.28 % / +0.65 %); MVPE -0.62 % / -1.13 %; wfinal +0.00 / -0.03. Training field 0.04712, +22.8 % over the control -- by far the worst fit of the round -- and training var +10.3 %
effect_zh: 代理集 sps +0.03、全划分 -0.14——一个分裂的判决，全划分那一半没过。rel-L2 在两个划分上都改善（-0.66 % / -0.63 %），而 TKE 把这点收益连本带利吐了回去（+1.28 % / +0.65 %）；MVPE -0.62 % / -1.13 %；wfinal +0.00 / -0.03。训练 field 0.04712，比对照高 22.8 %——本轮拟合最差——训练 var +10.3 %
note: THE DROPOUT AXIS NOW HAS AN INTERIOR OPTIMUM AND IS CLOSED AT BOTH ENDS. Three measured points at w96/L8: 0.30 -> 0.45 -> 0.60 is worth 0.00 -> +0.18/+0.36 sps (round 16's best arm) -> +0.03/-0.14. Dropout is one of only two axes that have ever paid at this operating point, and this establishes that 0.45 is its optimum rather than a waypoint -- which matters because the temptation after round 14 (+0.200 on the board from dropout) and round 16 (depth) was to keep pushing the same lever. It also shows the mechanism: at 0.60 the model can no longer fit (training field +22.8 %) and the composed field's amplitude is what pays, exactly the rel-L2 <-> TKE exchange every other arm of this round traced.
note_zh: dropout 这条轴如今有了一个内部最优点，并且两端都已关闭。w96/L8 上有三个测量点：0.30 -> 0.45 -> 0.60 分别值 0.00 -> +0.18/+0.36 sps（第 16 轮最好的臂）-> +0.03/-0.14。dropout 是这个工作点上仅有的两条曾经买过单的轴之一，而这次确立了 0.45 是它的最优点、而不是路上的一站——这一点很重要，因为在第 14 轮（dropout 在 board 上 +0.200）和第 16 轮（深度）之后，人们很容易想继续推同一根杠杆。它也显示了机制：在 0.60 时模型已经拟合不动（训练 field +22.8 %），付账的是合成场的幅度，正是本轮其他每一个臂都描出的那条 rel-L2 与 TKE 的交换。

arm: --lr 1e-4 at w96 / L8 / do45 (half the learning rate the project has used since round 4)
arm_zh: 在 w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --lr 1e-4（第 4 轮以来项目一直使用的学习率的一半）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r16_w96_do45_L8; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; drop rule = beat the control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the seed floor (0.00 proxy / 0.05 full) without losing rel-L2
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；淘汰规则 = 两个划分上的 sps 都要超过对照且幅度大于种子底噪（代理集 0.00 / 全划分 0.05），同时不能损失 rel-L2
effect: sps +0.06 proxy / -0.11 full -- SPLIT, fails. Held-out rel-L2 is flat (-0.19 % / +0.00 %) and TKE barely moves (-0.39 % / -0.10 %); wfinal +0.03 / -0.02. Training field 0.04297, +12.0 % over the control: it is simply under-trained at a fixed 400 epochs
effect_zh: 代理集 sps +0.06、全划分 -0.11——分裂，没过。留出集 rel-L2 基本持平（-0.19 % / +0.00 %），TKE 也几乎不动（-0.39 % / -0.10 %）；wfinal +0.03 / -0.02。训练 field 0.04297，比对照高 12.0 %：在固定 400 轮下它就是没训练够
note: Half the LEARNING RATE at a fixed epoch budget is an under-training arm, not a regularization arm, and it reads exactly that way: 12 % worse training fit, held-out rel-L2 unchanged. Read with lr4e-4 it brackets the optimum from below. The axis was worth one bracket because lr has been 2e-4 since round 4 and was never re-swept after width went 24 -> 96 or depth 4 -> 8, i.e. across a 4x-wider and 2x-deeper trunk at a dropout that did not exist then.
note_zh: 在固定训练轮数预算下把学习率减半，是一个「欠训练」的实验臂，而不是一个正则化的实验臂，读出来也正是如此：训练拟合差 12 %，留出集 rel-L2 纹丝不动。与 lr4e-4 合起来读，它从下方夹住了最优点。这条轴值得花一次夹逼，因为 lr 自第 4 轮以来一直是 2e-4，在宽度 24 -> 96、深度 4 -> 8 之后从未重扫过，也就是说，跨过了一个宽 4 倍、深 2 倍、且带着当时并不存在的 dropout 的主干。

arm: --lr 4e-4 at w96 / L8 / do45 (double the learning rate)
arm_zh: 在 w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --lr 4e-4（学习率加倍）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r16_w96_do45_L8; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; drop rule = beat the control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the seed floor (0.00 proxy / 0.05 full) without losing rel-L2
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；淘汰规则 = 两个划分上的 sps 都要超过对照且幅度大于种子底噪（代理集 0.00 / 全划分 0.05），同时不能损失 rel-L2
effect: sps -0.01 proxy / +0.05 full -- both AT the floor, fails. rel-L2 -0.09 % / -0.25 %, TKE +0.59 % / +0.10 %, MVPE -0.31 % / -0.28 %; wfinal -0.01 / +0.02. Training field 0.03565, -7.1 %: the ONLY arm in Q2c that fits better than the control, and it hands the gain straight back on TKE
effect_zh: 代理集 sps -0.01、全划分 +0.05——两格都贴着底噪，没过。rel-L2 -0.09 % / -0.25 %，TKE +0.59 % / +0.10 %，MVPE -0.31 % / -0.28 %；wfinal -0.01 / +0.02。训练 field 0.03565，-7.1 %：是 Q2c 里唯一比对照拟合得更好的臂，而它把这份收益原样在 TKE 上还了回去
note: TOGETHER WITH lr1e-4 THIS CLOSES THE LEARNING-RATE AXIS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: 2e-4 is correct at w96/L8/do45. Doubling the rate fits 7.1 % better and generalizes no better, halving it fits 12 % worse and generalizes no better, and neither moves sps outside the seed floor. The bracket is what makes this a result rather than a null -- a single arm on one side would have left the optimum unlocated. It is also the fifth instance of this round's recurring shape: an arm improves rel-L2 or training fit, pays it back on TKE, and leaves sps stationary.
note_zh: 与 lr1e-4 合起来，这从两个方向关闭了学习率这条轴：在 w96/L8/do45 上 2e-4 就是对的。加倍学习率拟合好了 7.1 %、泛化没变好；减半拟合差了 12 %、泛化也没变好；两者都没能把 sps 推出种子底噪。真正让它成为一个结论而不是零结果的，是这次夹逼——只在一侧放一个臂，最优点的位置仍然无法确定。它同时也是本轮反复出现的那个形状的第五个实例：一个臂改善了 rel-L2 或训练拟合，在 TKE 上还回去，而 sps 纹丝不动。

arm: --phases 4 at 400 epochs (4x the real views AND 4x the optimizer steps) at w96 / L8 / do45
arm_zh: 400 轮的 --phases 4（真实视图与优化步数同时乘以 4）在 w96 / L8 / do45 上
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r16_w96_do45_L8; 48,160 windows x 400 epochs = 601,600 optimizer steps against the control's 150,400; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on both splits, scored in ONE table with ph4e100 and augs25 so all four models share one band fit
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 逐位匹配；48,160 个窗口 x 400 轮 = 601,600 个优化步，对照是 150,400；在两个划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与 ph4e100、augs25 放在同一张表里打分，使四个模型共用同一次频带拟合
effect: sps 43.71 vs 43.97 proxy (-0.26) and 50.43 vs 50.40 full (+0.03): fails, and it is the WORST of the three data arms. rel-L2 +0.94 % / +0.38 % worse, TKE +2.39 % / +0.55 % worse, MVPE +0.10 % / +0.14 % worse; wfinal -0.13 / -0.01. Training field 0.03178, -17.2 % below the control -- the largest training gain anywhere in round 17 -- with training var -3.1 %
note: THIS COMPLETES THE 2x2 AND CLOSES THE REAL-DATA AXIS. The four corners are now: control; e800 (round 16, 2x steps on 1x data) neutral at -0.06/+0.05; ph4e100 (4x views, EQUAL steps) rel -0.4 % / TKE +0.9 % / sps flat; and this arm (4x views, 4x steps) worse on everything. MORE STEPS ON CORRELATED VIEWS IS CLOSER TO MORE EPOCHS THAN TO MORE DATA, and it over-fits: 17.2 % better training fit and the worst held-out rel-L2 and TKE of the three. Round 16 had already established the do45 model is not under-trained at 400 epochs, so quadrupling the steps was predicted to be neutral-at-best and turns out to be actively harmful. Round 15's explanation -- 'the three extra decimation phases are correlated views, not independent data' -- is now confirmed a third time and from a new direction. It was still worth the 5.2 GPU-h: this was the one cell of the 2x2 nobody had run, and running it is what turns 'the axis looks null' into 'the axis is closed'. Across the ten Q2 arms exactly one clears the drop rule, sim, and it is not a real-data arm.
note_zh: 这一臂补全了 2x2，也关闭了真实数据这条轴。四个角现在是：对照；e800（第 16 轮，1 倍数据、2 倍步数）中性，-0.06/+0.05；ph4e100（4 倍视图、等步数）rel -0.4 % / TKE +0.9 % / sps 不动；以及这一臂（4 倍视图、4 倍步数），样样更差。在相关视图上增加步数，本质上更接近增加训练轮数而不是增加数据，于是它过拟合了：训练拟合好了 17.2 %，而留出集的 rel-L2 和 TKE 是三者中最差的。第 16 轮已经确认 do45 模型在 400 轮时并不欠训练，所以把步数翻两番在预期上最多是中性，实测则是有害的。第 15 轮的解释——「那三个额外的抽取相位是相关的视图，不是独立的数据」——如今第三次得到确认，而且来自一个新的方向。这 5.2 GPU 小时仍然值得：这是 2x2 里唯一没人跑过的格子，把它跑出来，才让「这条轴看起来是零」变成「这条轴已经关闭」。在十个 Q2 实验臂里，恰好只有一个通过了淘汰规则，就是 sim，而它并不是一个真实数据的臂。

arm: sim co-training at w96 / L8 / do45, THREE seeds, tested at 3-vs-3 ensemble size (--sim --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full --sim-exclude-held, leak-free domain map)
arm_zh: w96 / L8 / do45 上的 sim 联合训练，三个种子，并在 3 对 3 集成规模上检验（--sim --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full --sim-exclude-held，无泄漏的域映射）
instrument: ens_v9.py 3-vs-3, band refit per set at 1.39x, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split; the three sim seeds are seed-matched to the three fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 twins, so the only difference between the two sets is the sim term; gate pre-registered before the seeds existed = beat the control trio on sps on BOTH splits by more than the seed floor (0.00 proxy / 0.05 full)
instrument_zh: ens_v9.py 3 对 3，每组各自重拟合频带、放大系数 1.39x，在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑；三个 sim 种子与三个 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 孪生模型逐一按种子配对，两组之间唯一的差别就是 sim 项；门槛在种子跑出来之前就已预注册 = 两个划分上的 sps 都要超过对照三元组，且幅度大于种子底噪（代理集 0.00 / 全划分 0.05）
note: THE PER-MODEL MARGIN IS RETAINED IN FULL AT ENSEMBLE SIZE: Q2c's one seed read +0.33 proxy / +0.12 full and the 3-vs-3 reads +0.33 / +0.15. That is the unusual part -- essentially every candidate since round 10 has died at this test, and round 10's --var-mlp lost 20 % of its per-model gain here. The mean of the three per-model rel-L2 deltas (-1.25 % / -0.85 %) agrees with the ensemble's (-1.15 % / -0.78 %) to ~0.1 pp, which is what a shared improvement looks like rather than three differently-wrong models cancelling. First arm since round 14's sim-on-relo to survive ROADMAP 1.15, and unlike that one it is measured in distribution, where the board lives. Two caveats stand: rel-L2 -1.2 % / -0.8 % is BELOW the board's ~4 % transfer resolution, so this can be real and still unreadable on the board; and the sim trio's full-split seed spread (0.12 sps) is larger than the 0.05 floor and about the size of the full-split margin itself, so a single sim seed there is not a readable measurement -- the ensemble is what makes it one. STAGING IS NOT DECIDED BY THIS ROW: the confirmation instrument is q3b's interior Re-band k-fold, bands 1-3 pooled, which round 16's U-FNO never ran and then missed the board by -0.45.
note_zh: 逐模型的优势在集成规模上被完整保留：Q2c 的单种子读到代理集 +0.33 / 全划分 +0.12，3 对 3 读到 +0.33 / +0.15。这才是不寻常之处——自第 10 轮以来几乎每一个候选都死在这一关，第 10 轮的 --var-mlp 在这里丢掉了它逐模型收益的 20 %。三个逐模型 rel-L2 差值的均值（-1.25 % / -0.85 %）与集成的差值（-1.15 % / -0.78 %）相差约 0.1 个百分点，这是「共同的改进」该有的样子，而不是三个各错各的模型互相抵消。这是自第 14 轮 sim 在 relo 上的结果之后，第一个通过 ROADMAP 1.15 的实验臂，而且与那一次不同，它是在分布之内测得的——正是排行榜所处的区域。两条保留意见依旧成立：rel-L2 -1.2 % / -0.8 % 低于排行榜约 4 % 的迁移分辨率，所以它可能是真的、却仍然在榜上读不出来；而 sim 三元组在全划分上的种子离散度（sps 0.12）大于 0.05 的底噪，且与全划分的优势幅度本身相当，因此在那里单个 sim 种子并不是一次可读的测量——是集成让它成为可读的。这一行并不决定是否上架：确认用的仪器是 q3b 的内部雷诺数分带 k 折（合并第 1-3 带），第 16 轮的 U-FNO 从未跑过它，随后在榜上差了 -0.45。

arm: --lam-sim 0.1 at w96 / L8 / do45 (a THIRD of the shipped sim weight)
arm_zh: w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --lam-sim 0.1（只有已上线仿真权重的三分之一）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth (same init, same batch order) and reading the SAME cached domain map simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy -- 92/100 trajectory-phases, 17,756 sim windows at stride 5, the VAL_TRAJ exclusion hash Q2c and Q3a used -- so the arms differ in nothing but the flag named; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with both controls (no-sim fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 and sim lam 0.3) so all five models share one band fit; read against the sim trio's own seed range from Q3a, 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配（同一初始化、同一批次顺序），并读取同一份缓存域映射 simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy——92/100 个轨迹相位、17,756 个 stride 5 的仿真窗口，即 Q2c 与 Q3a 用的那个 VAL_TRAJ 排除哈希——因此各臂之间除了所标注的那个开关以外没有任何差别；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与两个对照（无仿真的 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 和 lam 0.3 的仿真）放在同一张表里打分，使五个模型共用同一次频带拟合；判读基准是 Q3a 测得的仿真三元组自身的种子离散度，代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: sps 44.27 proxy / 50.53 full against the no-sim control's 43.97 / 50.40 -- +0.30 / +0.13, i.e. ESSENTIALLY THE WHOLE GAIN of lam 0.3 (+0.33 / +0.12) at a tenth of the gradient weight. rel-L2 0.1051 / 0.0781, TKE 0.4870 / 0.5034 (the BEST TKE of any sim arm), MVPE 0.0943 / 0.0697; wfinal 82.640 / 84.847. Training field 0.03907, only +1.8 % above the no-sim control against lam 0.3's +4.9 %, with the unweighted sim term at 0.15624 (vs 0.11496 at lam 0.3) -- barely perturbed and still buying the full containment gain
effect_zh: 代理集 sps 44.27 / 全划分 50.53，对照（无仿真）是 43.97 / 50.40——即 +0.30 / +0.13，几乎就是 lam 0.3 的全部收益（+0.33 / +0.12），而梯度权重只有其十分之一。rel-L2 0.1051 / 0.0781，TKE 0.4870 / 0.5034（所有仿真臂里最好的 TKE），MVPE 0.0943 / 0.0697；wfinal 82.640 / 84.847。训练 field 0.03907，只比无仿真对照高 1.8 %，而 lam 0.3 高 4.9 %，未加权的 sim 项为 0.15624（lam 0.3 是 0.11496）——几乎没被扰动，却买到了全部的覆盖收益
note: THIS IS THE ARM THAT SAYS SIM IS A REGULARIZER, NOT DATA. A term whose gradient weight is cut 3x from the shipped value, whose own loss is correspondingly 36 % worse fitted, and whose effect on the real training objective is +1.8 % instead of +4.9 %, delivers the SAME held-out containment gain. A data term's value scales with its weight; a regularizer's does not -- what it supplies is extra, differently-distributed windows in every step. That reading is consistent with q3b's interior k-fold, where the sim effect is real (rel-L2 z -4.49) but only -0.65 % with a TKE null: a regularizer of this size should show up as a real but sub-resolution improvement, and it does. Legitimate alternative to 0.3 if a future arm needs the sim gradient smaller; it is the cheapest point on the dose curve and costs nothing measured.
note_zh: 正是这一臂说明仿真是正则化项而不是数据。把梯度权重从已上线值再砍到三分之一，它自己的损失相应地差了 36 %，它对真实训练目标的扰动从 +4.9 % 降到 +1.8 %——而留出集上的覆盖收益一模一样。数据项的价值会随权重变化，正则化项不会：它提供的是每一步里额外的、分布不同的窗口。这个判读与 q3b 的内部 k 折一致：那里仿真的效应是真的（rel-L2 z -4.49），但只有 -0.65 %，而且 TKE 是零结果——这个量级的正则化项本就应该表现为「真实但低于分辨率」，事实正是如此。如果将来某个臂需要更小的仿真梯度，0.1 是合理的替代：它是剂量曲线上最便宜的一点，实测没有任何代价。

arm: --lam-sim 1.0 at w96 / L8 / do45 (3.3x the shipped sim weight)
arm_zh: w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --lam-sim 1.0（已上线仿真权重的 3.3 倍）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth (same init, same batch order) and reading the SAME cached domain map simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy -- 92/100 trajectory-phases, 17,756 sim windows at stride 5, the VAL_TRAJ exclusion hash Q2c and Q3a used -- so the arms differ in nothing but the flag named; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with both controls (no-sim fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 and sim lam 0.3) so all five models share one band fit; read against the sim trio's own seed range from Q3a, 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配（同一初始化、同一批次顺序），并读取同一份缓存域映射 simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy——92/100 个轨迹相位、17,756 个 stride 5 的仿真窗口，即 Q2c 与 Q3a 用的那个 VAL_TRAJ 排除哈希——因此各臂之间除了所标注的那个开关以外没有任何差别；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与两个对照（无仿真的 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 和 lam 0.3 的仿真）放在同一张表里打分，使五个模型共用同一次频带拟合；判读基准是 Q3a 测得的仿真三元组自身的种子离散度，代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: sps 44.32 proxy / 50.52 full -- +0.35 / +0.12 over the no-sim control and INDISTINGUISHABLE from lam 0.3 (44.30 / 50.52). But the error metrics split: rel-L2 is the BEST of every arm (0.1045 / 0.0776, -0.4 % / -0.4 % against lam 0.3) while TKE is the WORST of every sim arm and is WORSE THAN THE NO-SIM CONTROL on the proxy (0.4934 against 0.4929; full 0.5063 against 0.5070, a tie). MVPE 0.0945 / 0.0695; wfinal 82.644 / 84.848. Training: field 0.04381 (+14.2 % over the no-sim control), tke 0.31490 (+9.6 % over lam 0.1), unweighted sim term 0.08287 -- 10x the weight buys only -47 % on the sim term while the real field term degrades +12.1 %
effect_zh: 代理集 sps 44.32 / 全划分 50.52——比无仿真对照高 +0.35 / +0.12，与 lam 0.3（44.30 / 50.52）无法区分。但误差指标分裂了：rel-L2 是所有臂里最好的（0.1045 / 0.0776，比 lam 0.3 再好 -0.4 % / -0.4 %），而 TKE 是所有仿真臂里最差的，在代理集上甚至比无仿真对照还差（0.4934 对 0.4929；全划分 0.5063 对 0.5070，基本打平）。MVPE 0.0945 / 0.0695；wfinal 82.644 / 84.848。训练侧：field 0.04381（比无仿真对照高 14.2 %），tke 0.31490（比 lam 0.1 高 9.6 %），未加权 sim 项 0.08287——权重放大 10 倍只换来 sim 项 -47 %，而真实 field 项却劣化了 +12.1 %
verdict: flat; TKE worse than no-sim at lam 1.0
note: THE DOSE IS FLAT IN sps AND NOT INVISIBLE IN THE ERRORS: across the 10x range rel-L2 is MONOTONE (0.1051 -> 0.1049 -> 0.1045 proxy, 0.0781 -> 0.0779 -> 0.0776 full, about -0.6 %) and TKE is ANTI-MONOTONE (0.4870 -> 0.4890 -> 0.4934). sps prices containment and the two trades cancel, which is why the sweep looks flat there. The training tke term moves the same way as the held-out one (0.28725 -> 0.29427 -> 0.31490), so this is not a generalization artefact: at high weight the model genuinely fits the real variance field less well because it must also fit a source sim_map.py measures at 2.9x the energy at k~1 and 5.6x at k~10. DECISION: do not go to 1.0. It buys 0.4 % of rel-L2 and hands back more than that in TKE, ending BELOW the no-sim control there, and it is the most expensive point on the curve in real-objective damage.
note_zh: 剂量在 sps 上是平的，在误差上却并非不可见：在 10 倍量程内 rel-L2 单调改善（代理集 0.1051 -> 0.1049 -> 0.1045，全划分 0.0781 -> 0.0779 -> 0.0776，约 -0.6 %），而 TKE 反向单调（0.4870 -> 0.4890 -> 0.4934）。sps 计价的是覆盖，两种交换恰好抵消，所以这条扫描在 sps 上看起来是平的。训练的 tke 项与留出集同向移动（0.28725 -> 0.29427 -> 0.31490），因此这不是泛化假象：在高权重下，模型确实把真实的方差场拟合得更差了，因为它同时还要拟合一个 sim_map.py 测得在 k~1 处能量为 2.9 倍、在 k~10 处为 5.6 倍的源。结论：不要调到 1.0。它买到 0.4 % 的 rel-L2，却在 TKE 上还回去更多，最终在那一项上低于无仿真对照，而且是整条曲线上对真实目标损害最大的一点。

effect: SPLITS and both halves are inside noise: sps 44.23 proxy -- the LOWEST of the four sim arms, 0.07 below lam 0.3 -- and 50.62 full, the HIGHEST, 0.10 above it. Against the no-sim do45 control that is +0.26 / +0.22. rel-L2 0.1055 / 0.0785 (the worst rel-L2 of the sim arms), TKE 0.4874 / 0.5035, MVPE 0.0940 / 0.0698; wfinal 82.620 / 84.859. Training field 0.03285 -- the best fit of round 17, -14.4 % below the no-sim control and below even lr4e-4's 0.03565 -- with var 0.28416
effect_zh: 结果分裂，而且两半都在噪声之内：代理集 sps 44.23——是四个仿真臂里最低的，比 lam 0.3 低 0.07——全划分 50.62，是最高的，比它高 0.10。相对无仿真的 do45 对照则是 +0.26 / +0.22。rel-L2 0.1055 / 0.0785（仿真臂里最差的 rel-L2），TKE 0.4874 / 0.5035，MVPE 0.0940 / 0.0698；wfinal 82.620 / 84.859。训练 field 0.03285——是第 17 轮拟合得最好的一次，比无仿真对照低 14.4 %，甚至低于 lr4e-4 的 0.03565——var 0.28416
note: SIM DOES NOT SUBSTITUTE FOR DROPOUT IN ANY READABLE WAY, and the training curve says why: at do30 the model fits the training set better than any other arm this round and generalizes no better, which is the signature of under-regularization that round 16's dropout ladder already established (0.30 -> 0.45 was worth +0.18/+0.36 sps, 0.45 -> 0.60 gave it back). The mapped sim windows are extra data, not extra noise on the weights, so they do not do dropout's job. do45 stays in the package. Note the sign disagreement between the two splits is itself the reading -- an arm that is best on one split and worst on the other, at 0.07-0.10 sps against a 0.05/0.12 seed floor, has not moved anything.
note_zh: 仿真在任何可读的意义上都无法替代 dropout，而训练曲线说明了原因：在 do30 下，模型对训练集的拟合优于本轮任何其他臂，泛化却没有变好，这正是欠正则化的特征，第 16 轮的 dropout 阶梯早已确立（0.30 -> 0.45 值 +0.18/+0.36 sps，0.45 -> 0.60 又还了回去）。映射后的仿真窗口是额外的数据，而不是加在权重上的额外噪声，所以它干不了 dropout 的活。包里保留 do45。还要注意，两个划分上的符号分歧本身就是判读结果——一个在一个划分上最好、在另一个划分上最差、幅度只有 0.07-0.10 sps 而种子底噪是 0.05/0.12 的臂，什么也没有移动。

arm: --sim-stride 2 at w96 / L8 / do45 (44,252 distinct sim windows against the shipped 17,756 at stride 5)
arm_zh: w96 / L8 / do45 上的 --sim-stride 2（44,252 个不同的仿真窗口，而已上线配方在 stride 5 下是 17,756 个）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth and reading the SAME cached domain map simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy (92/100 trajectory-phases), so nothing differs but the flag named; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with both controls (no-sim fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 and the shipped sim recipe) so all four models share one band fit; read against the sim trio's own seed range from Q3a, 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配，并读取同一份缓存域映射 simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy（92/100 个轨迹相位），因此除了所标注的那个开关以外没有任何差别；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与两个对照（无仿真的 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 和已上线的仿真配方）放在同一张表里打分，使四个模型共用同一次频带拟合；判读基准是 Q3a 测得的仿真三元组种子离散度，代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: A NULL TO FOUR DECIMALS ON EVERYTHING. Proxy sps 44.30 against the sim control's 44.30, full 50.52 against 50.52; rel-L2 0.1049 / 0.0779 identical to four decimals on both splits, MVPE 0.0948 / 0.0698 identical, TKE differs by 0.0002 proxy and 0.0001 full; wfinal 82.641 / 84.847 against 82.642 / 84.846. The training curve is indistinguishable too: field 0.04028 against 0.04026 (+0.05 %), var 0.31547 against 0.31543, tke 0.29430 against 0.29427. The one number that DID move is the unweighted sim term, 0.11613 against 0.11496 (+1.0 %) -- a larger, more varied pool is marginally harder to fit
effect_zh: 在所有指标上都是四位小数级别的零结果。代理集 sps 44.30 对仿真对照的 44.30，全划分 50.52 对 50.52；两个划分上 rel-L2 0.1049 / 0.0779 四位小数完全相同，MVPE 0.0948 / 0.0698 完全相同，TKE 代理集差 0.0002、全划分差 0.0001；wfinal 82.641 / 84.847 对 82.642 / 84.846。训练曲线同样无法区分：field 0.04028 对 0.04026（+0.05 %），var 0.31547 对 0.31543，tke 0.29430 对 0.29427。唯一真的动了的数字是未加权的 sim 项，0.11613 对 0.11496（+1.0 %）——更大、更多样的池子确实略微更难拟合
note: THE ARM IS A NULL AND NOT A VOID -- the sampler was checked. train2.py:874-878 draws one sim batch per real step, freshly and with replacement, as sim_idx_t[torch.randint(len(sim_idx_t), (32,))], and sim_idx_t is window_index(sim_trajs, sim_stride), so at stride 2 the pool is a DIFFERENT set of 44,252 (traj, start) pairs containing starts at t = 2,4,6,8 mod 10 that stride 5 never holds, randint draws from a different bound, and the sim batch sequence diverges from step one. The log's '44252 windows at stride 2' and the +1.0 % sim term both confirm the pool really changed. WHY IT CHANGES NOTHING ANYWAY: 377 steps/epoch x 32 samples x 400 epochs = 4.83 M sim draws, i.e. 272 views of each of the 17,756 windows at stride 5 against 109 views of each of the 44,252 at stride 2 -- both deep in the saturated regime -- and consecutive stride-2 windows overlap in 18 of their 20 input frames. 2.5x the windows is 2.5x more CORRELATED views, not 2.5x more information, which is round 15's --phases verdict reappearing on the sim side for the third time in this project. Read with q3d: a term whose value does not scale with its WEIGHT does not scale with its DIVERSITY either, and both facts point at the same mechanism -- sim supplies perturbation from a related distribution, and one such perturbation is as good as another once the pool is large enough.
note_zh: 这是零结果而不是无效实验——采样器已经查过。train2.py:874-878 在每个真实数据步上重新有放回地抽一批仿真样本，写作 sim_idx_t[torch.randint(len(sim_idx_t), (32,))]，而 sim_idx_t 是 window_index(sim_trajs, sim_stride)；所以在 stride 2 下，池子是另一组 44,252 个 (轨迹, 起点) 对，其中包含 t = 2,4,6,8 mod 10 这些 stride 5 从不持有的起点，randint 的上界也不同，仿真批次序列从第一步起就分岔了。日志里的「44252 windows at stride 2」和 +1.0 % 的 sim 项都证实池子确实变了。那为什么还是什么都没变：377 步/轮 x 32 个样本 x 400 轮 = 483 万次仿真抽样，即 stride 5 下每个 17,756 个窗口被看 272 次，stride 2 下每个 44,252 个窗口被看 109 次——两者都深深处于饱和区——而 stride 2 相邻窗口的 20 帧输入里有 18 帧是重叠的。2.5 倍的窗口数是 2.5 倍的相关视图，而不是 2.5 倍的信息量，这正是第 15 轮 --phases 的结论在仿真这一侧的重现，也是本项目中的第三次。与 q3d 合起来读：一个价值不随权重变化的项，其价值同样不随多样性变化，两个事实指向同一个机制——仿真提供的是来自相关分布的扰动，而一旦池子足够大，哪一种扰动都一样。

arm: 600 epochs with sim at w96 / L8 / do45 (1.5x the shipped schedule)
arm_zh: w96 / L8 / do45 上带仿真训练 600 轮（已上线训练计划的 1.5 倍）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth and reading the SAME cached domain map simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy (92/100 trajectory-phases), so nothing differs but the flag named; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with both controls (no-sim fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 and the shipped sim recipe) so all four models share one band fit; read against the sim trio's own seed range from Q3a, 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配，并读取同一份缓存域映射 simmap_p1_f0_x476193e300.npy（92/100 个轨迹相位），因此除了所标注的那个开关以外没有任何差别；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与两个对照（无仿真的 fno_r16_w96_do45_L8 和已上线的仿真配方）放在同一张表里打分，使四个模型共用同一次频带拟合；判读基准是 Q3a 测得的仿真三元组种子离散度，代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: SPLITS INSIDE THE FLOOR: proxy sps 44.24 against the sim control's 44.30 (-0.06) and full 50.58 against 50.52 (+0.06), both under the 0.05 / 0.12 seed floor. rel-L2 0.1050 / 0.0779 (flat), TKE 0.4892 proxy (+0.04 %) but 0.5027 full (-0.28 %, the best TKE of any sim arm on that split), MVPE 0.0946 / 0.0697; wfinal 82.628 / 84.865. The training fit is clearly better, as 1.5x the steps should make it: field 0.03759 (-6.6 %), var 0.30347 (-3.8 %), tke 0.27894 (-5.2 %), sim term 0.10904 (-5.1 %)
verdict: split inside the floor; not step-limited
note: THE SIM RECIPE IS NOT STEP-LIMITED AT 400 EPOCHS. 1.5x the steps buys 6.6 % of training fit and returns none of it on either split -- the classic mild-overfit signature, and the fifth instance this round of 'fits better, generalizes the same'. Round 16 established the same thing at 800 epochs WITHOUT sim; the open question was whether adding a second distribution (~2.3x the windows seen per epoch) would make the model want a longer schedule, and it does not. Note the one direction worth remembering: full-split TKE is the best of any sim arm here (0.5027), which is the same anti-monotone-in-training-fit pattern q3d found on the lam axis, seen from the schedule side. Not a reason to ship 600 epochs -- it is inside the floor on sps and costs 1.5x the GPU time per member.
note_zh: 在 400 轮时，这套仿真配方并不受步数限制。1.5 倍的步数换来 6.6 % 的训练拟合改善，而在两个划分上一点都没还回来——典型的轻微过拟合特征，也是本轮第五次出现「拟合更好、泛化不变」。第 16 轮在不带仿真的情况下用 800 轮确认过同一件事；本来悬而未决的问题是：加入第二个分布（每轮看到的窗口约为 2.3 倍）会不会让模型想要更长的训练计划——答案是不会。值得记住的一个方向：这里全划分的 TKE 是所有仿真臂中最好的（0.5027），这与 q3d 在 lam 轴上发现的「与训练拟合反向」的模式是同一种，只是从训练计划这一侧看过去。这不构成上线 600 轮的理由——它在 sps 上处于底噪之内，而每个成员要多花 1.5 倍的 GPU 时间。

arm: --sim-map std (the twin's PER-PIXEL fluctuation amplitude instead of one scalar ratio)
arm_zh: --sim-map std（用孪生轨迹的逐像素脉动幅度替代单一标量比值）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth, same lam_sim 0.3 and the same 17,756 windows at stride 5; the map is REBUILT per mode (26 conditions on the freestream law, 8 real trajectories withheld from the twin table -- the same count as Q2c, so round 14's leak guard is untouched, and the per-pixel modes are twin-only so a twin-less condition falls back to scalar) and cached under a mode tag plus the VAL_TRAJ hash so it cannot be confused with the scalar map; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with the no-sim control and the scalar-map sim so all four models share one band fit; seed floor 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配，同样的 lam_sim 0.3 和同样的 17,756 个 stride 5 窗口；映射按模式重建（26 个条件走自由流定律，8 条真实轨迹从孪生表中扣除——与 Q2c 计数相同，因此第 14 轮的泄漏防护未被触动，而逐像素模式是「仅孪生」的，没有孪生的条件回落到 scalar），缓存文件名带模式标签和 VAL_TRAJ 哈希，因此不会与 scalar 映射混淆；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与无仿真对照和 scalar 映射的仿真放在同一张表里打分，使四个模型共用同一次频带拟合；种子底噪为代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: LOSES ON THE PROXY, AT THE FLOOR ON FULL. Proxy sps 44.26 against the scalar map's 44.30 (-0.04) and full 50.54 against 50.52 (+0.02); rel-L2 0.1054 / 0.0782 against 0.1049 / 0.0779 (+0.48 % / +0.39 % WORSE), TKE 0.4890 / 0.5034 (flat proxy, -0.14 % full), MVPE 0.0949 / 0.0701 (+0.11 % / +0.43 % worse); wfinal 82.622 / 84.845 against 82.642 / 84.846. Still above the no-sim control (+0.29 proxy / +0.14 full). Training: field 0.03966 against the scalar's 0.04026 -- only +3.4 % above the no-sim control's 0.03837 where scalar is +4.9 % -- and the unweighted sim term collapses to 0.08180, -28.8 % against scalar, at the SAME lam
verdict: loses on the proxy, floor on full; monotone toward meanstd
note: THE SIM TERM IS THE TELL: making sim more real-like makes the sim windows 29 % EASIER to fit at the same lam, and moves the real training objective back toward the no-sim control (+4.9 % -> +3.4 %). The per-pixel map does exactly what it was designed to do -- it removes one of the two static fields sim_map.py measures sim to be wrong about -- and the measurable consequence is that sim stops perturbing the training problem. THE CLAMP IS NOT THE EXPLANATION: 31.3 % of live elements sit at the clamp (max 47.6 % on 26700_15), so this map is only about two-thirds per-pixel, yet the response is ORDERED across scalar -> std -> meanstd and meanstd differs by replacing the time-mean field, which the clamp does not touch. Kept in the code as a closed arm: the mode='scalar' cache tag is empty by construction, so the default is bit-identical and jobs straddling the commit read the identical cache file.
note_zh: sim 项本身就是线索：把仿真做得更像真实，会让仿真窗口在同样的 lam 下好拟合 29 %，并把真实训练目标拉回到接近无仿真对照（+4.9 % -> +3.4 %）。逐像素映射确实做到了它被设计要做的事——移除 sim_map.py 测出仿真弄错的两个静态场之一——而可测量的后果是：仿真不再扰动训练问题了。夹紧并不是解释：31.3 % 的活跃元素落在夹紧边界上（26700_15 最高达 47.6 %），所以这份映射其实只有大约三分之二是逐像素的；然而响应在 scalar -> std -> meanstd 上是有序的，而 meanstd 的差别在于替换了时间平均场，那是夹紧根本碰不到的东西。代码里作为一个已关闭的实验臂保留：mode='scalar' 的缓存标签按构造为空，因此默认路径逐位不变，跨越那次提交的作业读到的是同一个缓存文件。

arm: --sim-map meanstd (per-pixel amplitude AND the twin's time-mean field replacing sim's)
arm_zh: --sim-map meanstd（逐像素幅度，外加用孪生轨迹的时间平均场替换仿真自己的）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth, same lam_sim 0.3 and the same 17,756 windows at stride 5; the map is REBUILT per mode (26 conditions on the freestream law, 8 real trajectories withheld from the twin table -- the same count as Q2c, so round 14's leak guard is untouched, and the per-pixel modes are twin-only so a twin-less condition falls back to scalar) and cached under a mode tag plus the VAL_TRAJ hash so it cannot be confused with the scalar map; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, scored in ONE table with the no-sim control and the scalar-map sim so all four models share one band fit; seed floor 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 逐位匹配，同样的 lam_sim 0.3 和同样的 17,756 个 stride 5 窗口；映射按模式重建（26 个条件走自由流定律，8 条真实轨迹从孪生表中扣除——与 Q2c 计数相同，因此第 14 轮的泄漏防护未被触动，而逐像素模式是「仅孪生」的，没有孪生的条件回落到 scalar），缓存文件名带模式标签和 VAL_TRAJ 哈希，因此不会与 scalar 映射混淆；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，并与无仿真对照和 scalar 映射的仿真放在同一张表里打分，使四个模型共用同一次频带拟合；种子底噪为代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12
effect: LOSES ON BOTH SPLITS AGAINST THE SCALAR MAP -- the first sim arm of round 17 to do so. Proxy sps 44.17 (-0.13, clears the 0.05 floor) and full 50.48 (-0.04, inside the floor); rel-L2 0.1059 / 0.0785 (+0.95 % / +0.77 % WORSE), TKE 0.4916 / 0.5047 (+0.53 % / +0.12 % worse), MVPE 0.0949 / 0.0701; wfinal 82.580 / 84.820 against 82.642 / 84.846. Still above the no-sim control (+0.20 proxy / +0.08 full). Training field 0.03960, +3.2 % above the no-sim control against scalar's +4.9 %, sim term 0.08335 (-27.5 % vs scalar)
verdict: loses on both splits vs the scalar map
note: THE MORE REAL-LIKE THE SIM, THE LESS IT IS WORTH -- monotone on the proxy in every metric: sps 44.30 -> 44.26 -> 44.17, rel-L2 0.1049 -> 0.1054 -> 0.1059, TKE 0.4890 -> 0.4890 -> 0.4916, with the full split agreeing on rel-L2. This falsifies the arm's own pre-registered hypothesis, which was that sim's unique value is the DYNAMICS and that copying more of real's static statistics would isolate it. The opposite holds: the statistics sim gets wrong are most of what the term contributes. Read with q3d (lam 0.1 perturbs training 1.8 % and buys the whole gain; lam 1.0 perturbs it 14 % and breaks TKE) and q3f (WHICH sim windows it sees does not matter at all), sim's value at this operating point is the value of a STRUCTURED PERTURBATION -- physically plausible dynamics whose statistics are wrong. Every change that makes it less wrong, or less present, removes value; changes that alter only which wrong windows appear do nothing. DECISION: --sim-map scalar stays. Sim-side preprocessing is now closed in BOTH directions -- less faithful (--sim-loss shape, round 14, -0.7 wfinal with MVPE +46 %) and more faithful (this) both lose to the three-scalar map, which is therefore an interior optimum on the faithfulness axis rather than a crude first attempt.
note_zh: 仿真越像真实，价值越小——在代理集上每一项指标都是单调的：sps 44.30 -> 44.26 -> 44.17，rel-L2 0.1049 -> 0.1054 -> 0.1059，TKE 0.4890 -> 0.4890 -> 0.4916，全划分在 rel-L2 上给出同样的方向。这否证了这一臂自己预注册的假设——原假设是仿真的独特价值在于「动力学」，把真实的静态统计更多地拷过去就能把它孤立出来。事实恰恰相反：仿真弄错的那些统计，正是这一项贡献的主要来源。与 q3d（lam 0.1 只扰动训练 1.8 % 就买到全部收益；lam 1.0 扰动 14 % 并破坏 TKE）和 q3f（看到的是哪些仿真窗口完全无关紧要）合起来读，在当前工作点上，仿真的价值就是「结构化扰动」的价值——物理上合理的动力学，配上错误的统计。任何让它更不错、或更少出现的改动都会削减价值；而只改变「出现哪些错误窗口」的改动则毫无影响。结论：保留 --sim-map scalar。仿真侧的预处理现在在两个方向上都关闭了——更不忠实（--sim-loss shape，第 14 轮，-0.7 wfinal，MVPE +46 %）和更忠实（本臂）都输给三标量映射，因此那份映射是忠实度轴上的内部最优点，而不是一次有待改进的粗糙尝试。

arm: --n-layers 12 WITH sim at w96 / do45 (does sim re-open the capacity axis Q2a closed?)
arm_zh: w96 / do45 上带仿真的 --n-layers 12（仿真能否重新打开 Q2a 关闭的容量轴？）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, the shipped sim recipe (lam 0.3, scalar map, do45) with the capacity flag changed, read against TWO controls in ONE compare_v9.py table so all six models share a band fit: fno_r17_sim.pth (the sim L8 recipe) and its own no-sim twin from Q2a (fno_r17_L12.pth / fno_r17_w128L8.pth, whose rows reproduce Q2a's exactly -- same checkpoints); compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; seed floor 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full; pre-registered price from the campaign's capacity table -- L12 = 3 fp16 members at most (3 sits exactly at the 256 MB cap), w128 = 2, plus 1.5x / 1.8x the FLOPs at -0.071 final per board ms
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，使用已上线的仿真配方（lam 0.3、scalar 映射、do45），只改容量开关；在同一张 compare_v9.py 表里对两个对照读数，使六个模型共用一次频带拟合：fno_r17_sim.pth（仿真 L8 配方）以及它自己在 Q2a 的无仿真孪生（fno_r17_L12.pth / fno_r17_w128L8.pth，其行与 Q2a 完全一致——同一批检查点）；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；种子底噪为代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12；预注册的代价来自本轮的容量表——L12 最多 3 个 fp16 成员（3 个正好卡在 256 MB 上限），w128 只有 2 个，另加 1.5 倍 / 1.8 倍的浮点运算量，每毫秒榜上延迟折合 -0.071 final
effect: AGAINST ITS OWN NO-SIM TWIN sim buys MORE at L12 than at L8: sps +0.37 proxy / +0.22 full (44.26 vs 43.89; 50.61 vs 50.39) against L8's +0.33 / +0.12, with rel-L2 -1.40 % / -1.14 %, TKE -1.63 % / -0.64 %, MVPE -0.31 % / 0.00 %. AGAINST THE SIM L8 RECIPE it FAILS: -0.04 proxy (below the 0.05 floor and negative) and +0.09 full (inside the 0.12 floor). The trade is rel-L2 for TKE -- rel 0.1056 / 0.0783 against sim L8's 0.1049 / 0.0779 (WORSE), TKE 0.4837 / 0.5003 against 0.4890 / 0.5041 (-1.08 % / -0.75 %), MVPE 0.0956 / 0.0707 (worse). Training field 0.03565 against the no-sim L12's 0.03411, i.e. sim costs +4.5 % of training fit at L12 against +4.9 % at L8
verdict: fails the proxy vs sim L8; TKE -1.1 %
note: SIM'S GAIN GROWS WITH CAPACITY -- the third independent line of evidence for the regularizer reading, after q3d's dose plateau and q3g's faithfulness inversion. A regularizer's value grows with the size of the model it regularizes, and the training curves show the perturbation is the SAME size at every capacity (+4.5 % at L12, +4.6 % at w128, +4.9 % at L8) while the held-out gain gets bigger (+0.33 -> +0.37 proxy). But growing faster than the L8 twin is not the same as beating the L8 SIM recipe, and by the pre-registered rule this arm does not: -0.04 on the proxy is a failure, not a tie. It would also cost 3 fp16 members at most out of 4 (42.63 M params, and 3 sits exactly at the 256 MB cap) plus 1.5x the FLOPs, which a proxy failure cannot pay for.
note_zh: 仿真的收益随容量增长——这是继 q3d 的剂量平台、q3g 的忠实度反转之后，支持「正则化项」判读的第三条独立证据。正则化项的价值会随它所正则化的模型规模而增长，而训练曲线显示扰动在每个容量上大小相同（L12 +4.5 %，w128 +4.6 %，L8 +4.9 %），留出集上的收益却变大了（代理集 +0.33 -> +0.37）。但「比 L8 孪生涨得更快」不等于「打败 L8 的仿真配方」，按预注册规则这一臂没有做到：代理集 -0.04 是失败，不是打平。它还要在 4 个 fp16 成员里最多只能放 3 个（42.63 M 参数，3 个正好卡在 256 MB 上限），外加 1.5 倍的浮点运算量——代理集上的失败付不起这个价。

arm: --width 128 at L8 WITH sim / do45 (the other half of the capacity-with-sim question)
arm_zh: w128 / L8 / do45 上带仿真（容量加仿真这个问题的另一半）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1, the shipped sim recipe (lam 0.3, scalar map, do45) with the capacity flag changed, read against TWO controls in ONE compare_v9.py table so all six models share a band fit: fno_r17_sim.pth (the sim L8 recipe) and its own no-sim twin from Q2a (fno_r17_L12.pth / fno_r17_w128L8.pth, whose rows reproduce Q2a's exactly -- same checkpoints); compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split; seed floor 0.05 sps proxy / 0.12 full; pre-registered price from the campaign's capacity table -- L12 = 3 fp16 members at most (3 sits exactly at the 256 MB cap), w128 = 2, plus 1.5x / 1.8x the FLOPs at -0.071 final per board ms
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，使用已上线的仿真配方（lam 0.3、scalar 映射、do45），只改容量开关；在同一张 compare_v9.py 表里对两个对照读数，使六个模型共用一次频带拟合：fno_r17_sim.pth（仿真 L8 配方）以及它自己在 Q2a 的无仿真孪生（fno_r17_L12.pth / fno_r17_w128L8.pth，其行与 Q2a 完全一致——同一批检查点）；在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上跑 compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39；种子底噪为代理集 0.05 sps / 全划分 0.12；预注册的代价来自本轮的容量表——L12 最多 3 个 fp16 成员（3 个正好卡在 256 MB 上限），w128 只有 2 个，另加 1.5 倍 / 1.8 倍的浮点运算量，每毫秒榜上延迟折合 -0.071 final
effect: AGAINST ITS OWN NO-SIM TWIN: sps +0.37 proxy / +0.20 full (44.33 vs 43.96; 50.68 vs 50.48), rel-L2 -1.40 % / -1.26 %, TKE -1.33 % / -0.73 %, MVPE -0.94 % / -0.85 % -- every metric better on both splits. AGAINST THE SIM L8 RECIPE: +0.03 proxy (a TIE, inside the 0.05 floor) and +0.16 full (a PASS, above the 0.12 floor). Again a rel-for-TKE trade: rel 0.1054 / 0.0784 against 0.1049 / 0.0779 (worse), MVPE 0.0948 / 0.0702 (tie / worse), TKE 0.4838 / 0.4999 against 0.4890 / 0.5041 (-1.06 % / -0.83 %) -- THE LOWEST SINGLE-MODEL TKE RECORDED IN ROUND 17 on both splits. Training field 0.03455 against the no-sim w128's 0.03304 (+4.6 %)
verdict: ties the proxy, passes full; rel<->TKE trade; costs 2 members
note: CAPACITY IS CLOSED A SECOND TIME, NOW WITH THE DATA THAT WAS SUPPOSED TO UNLOCK IT. Round 14 argued the shipped model underfits and that every data-side null had been measured on a model that could not fit what it already had; Q2a closed the capacity ladder without sim; this arm re-opens it WITH 15.6 k extra mapped windows per epoch and it closes again -- a tie on the proxy and a pass on the full split, against a price of 2 fp16 members out of 4 (50.53 M params under the 256 MB cap) plus 1.8x the FLOPs. Q1c measured 8 members ~ 4, but 4 -> 2 is UNMEASURED and round 8's curve says the first members are the valuable ones, so a proxy tie cannot pay for halving the ensemble. THE ONE THING WORTH KEEPING: if int8 packing (plan Q5, unbuilt) ever makes width-128 members free inside the cap, this is the arm to revisit and the case to make is TKE -- it is the only round-17 lever that moved TKE by more than 1 % without paying it back somewhere the free weights care about more, and TKE is worth 0.1017 per point.
note_zh: 容量第二次被关闭，而且这一次是带着本应解锁它的数据。第 14 轮论证过：上线的模型欠拟合，而所有数据侧的零结果都是在一个连手上已有数据都拟合不了的模型上测的；Q2a 在没有仿真的情况下关闭了容量阶梯；这一臂带着每轮多出的 1.56 万个映射窗口重新打开它，结果又关上了——代理集打平、全划分通过，代价却是 4 个 fp16 成员里只剩 2 个（50.53 M 参数，256 MB 上限）外加 1.8 倍的浮点运算量。Q1c 测过 8 个成员约等于 4 个，但 4 -> 2 从未测过，而第 8 轮的曲线说前几个成员才是值钱的，所以代理集上的打平付不起把集成砍半的代价。唯一值得记住的一点：如果 int8 打包（计划 Q5，尚未实现）某天让 width-128 成员在容量上限内变成免费的，那就回来重做这一臂，而且要打的牌是 TKE——它是第 17 轮唯一让 TKE 改善超过 1 % 而没有在自由权重更看重的地方还回去的杠杆，而 TKE 每分值 0.1017。

arm: mixed ensembles of the round's held-out twins: sim x3 + the three no-sim L8 twins (6 members, ONE fused group), and sim x3 + the capacity-with-sim members simw128 / simL12 (each its own group, +1 invocation each)
arm_zh: 本轮留出孪生模型的混合集成：仿真 x3 加上三个无仿真 L8 孪生（6 个成员，同一个融合组），以及仿真 x3 加上带仿真的容量成员 simw128 / simL12（每个自成一组，各多一次调用）
instrument: ens_v9.py over six sets, band refit per set at 1.39x, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split, eval only on checkpoints that already existed (00:04:06, 0.07 GPU-h); read against S2 = the sim trio (the shipped recipe) with S1 = the no-sim L8 trio as the reference the round started from; latency priced from Q1c (8 members give back 0.09-0.10 final to latency at w96 L8) and from the board-latency fit (1 invocation ~ -0.036 final)
instrument_zh: 对六个集合跑 ens_v9.py，每组各自重拟合频带、放大系数 1.39x，在 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分上打分；纯评测，用的都是已有的检查点（00:04:06，0.07 GPU 小时）；判读基准是 S2＝仿真三元组（已上线配方），S1＝无仿真 L8 三元组是本轮出发时的参照；延迟按 Q1c（在 w96 L8 上 8 个成员要把 0.09-0.10 final 还给延迟）和榜上延迟拟合（一次调用约 -0.036 final）计价
effect: SIX MEMBERS = THREE. sim x3 + L8 x3 (S3) against sim x3 (S2): sps 37.57 -> 37.57 proxy (+0.00) and 44.13 -> 44.20 full (+0.07), with TKE slightly WORSE on the proxy (0.4859 against 0.4844, +0.31 %); rel-L2 0.1025 / 0.0763, MVPE 0.0928 / 0.0685. S6 (swap ONE sim member for a no-sim one) costs -0.13 proxy / -0.08 full with every error metric worse (rel +0.29 %, TKE +0.27 %, MVPE +0.65 %). CAPACITY MEMBERS DO BUY TKE: S5 (sim x3 + simw128 + simL12, 3 invocations) is TKE -0.52 % proxy / -0.38 % full, rel-L2 -0.39 % / -0.39 %, MVPE -0.43 % / -0.29 %, sps +0.11 / +0.13; S4 (4 members, 2 invocations) is +0.07 / +0.09 sps
effect_zh: 六个成员等于三个。仿真 x3 加 L8 x3（S3）对仿真 x3（S2）：代理集 sps 37.57 -> 37.57（+0.00），全划分 44.13 -> 44.20（+0.07），而代理集上的 TKE 反而更差（0.4859 对 0.4844，+0.31 %）；rel-L2 0.1025 / 0.0763，MVPE 0.0928 / 0.0685。S6（把其中一个仿真成员换成无仿真成员）代价是代理集 -0.13 / 全划分 -0.08，每一项误差都更差（rel +0.29 %，TKE +0.27 %，MVPE +0.65 %）。容量成员确实能买到 TKE：S5（仿真 x3 加 simw128 加 simL12，3 次调用）TKE 代理集 -0.52 % / 全划分 -0.38 %，rel-L2 -0.39 % / -0.39 %，MVPE -0.43 % / -0.29 %，sps +0.11 / +0.13；S4（4 个成员，2 次调用）sps 是 +0.07 / +0.09
verdict: no-sim members add nothing; capacity members cost an invocation each
note: TWO CLOSURES FOR 4 GPU-MINUTES, BOTH FROM CHECKPOINTS THAT ALREADY EXISTED. (i) Doubling the ensemble across a different TRAINING DISTRIBUTION -- not merely different seeds -- reproduces Q1c's 8 ~ 4 exactly, and S6 explains why: the no-sim members are simply WEAKER members, not diverse ones, so a mixed set lands between its two ingredients rather than above them. Round 8's 'architecture beats seeds' was measured across architectures at w24 and does not reproduce for a training-distribution difference at w96 L8. Since three extra fused members also cost the latency Q1c priced at 0.09-0.10 final, the honest reading of S3 is not 'buys nothing' but 'costs ~0.07-0.09 of latency for ~0.00 of accuracy' -- an all-data 4 sim + 4 no-sim package is NOT worth building. (ii) Q3e's per-model TKE gain survives ensembling and the rel-L2 cost does NOT (the three sim L8 members carry the field), but each capacity member is its own StackedFNO group: S5's accuracy is ~+0.05 final at the optimistic end against 2 extra invocations at -0.036 each, and S4 is +0.03 against -0.036. Both net negative before the proxy's standing 1-2 pp optimism. NOTHING CHANGES FOR THE STAGED SIM PAIR, which is sim x4 all-data in one fused invocation: its two plausible extensions are worth <= 0 each.
note_zh: 四个 GPU 分钟关掉两个问题，而且用的全是已有的检查点。(i) 跨越不同训练分布——不只是不同种子——把集成翻倍，精确复现了 Q1c 的「8 约等于 4」，而 S6 解释了原因：无仿真成员只是更弱的成员，而不是带来多样性的成员，所以混合集合落在两种配料之间而不是之上。第 8 轮「架构胜过种子」是在 w24 上跨架构测的，在 w96 L8 上换成训练分布的差异并不复现。既然多出的三个融合成员还要付 Q1c 计价为 0.09-0.10 final 的延迟，那么对 S3 的诚实判读不是「毫无收益」，而是「用约 0.07-0.09 的延迟换来约 0.00 的精度」——全数据 4 仿真 + 4 无仿真的包不值得做。(ii) Q3e 逐模型的 TKE 收益在集成后仍然存在，而 rel-L2 的代价消失了（场由三个仿真 L8 成员扛着），但每个容量成员都是自己的 StackedFNO 组：S5 的精度收益乐观估计约 +0.05 final，对上两次额外调用、每次 -0.036；S4 是 +0.03 对 -0.036。在还没算上代理集一贯 1-2 个百分点的乐观偏差之前，两者就都是净负。对已经上架的仿真配对没有任何改变——它是全数据的仿真 x4、单次融合调用：它两条看似合理的扩展路线，每一条的价值都不超过零。

arm: --aux-fstride 2 --lam-aux 0.3, no sim (a structured perturbation built from REAL data: real windows at frame stride 2, i.e. the same wake at 2x its shedding frequency)
arm_zh: --aux-fstride 2 --lam-aux 0.3，不用仿真（用真实数据构造的结构化扰动：帧步长 2 的真实窗口，也就是同一个尾流以 2 倍脱落频率演化）
instrument: one arm, --seed 1 on the w96 L8 do45 400-epoch recipe, so it shares its initialization with both controls (fno_r16_w96_do45_L8.pth and fno_r17_sim.pth) though not its batch order (the aux draw consumes from the same CPU generator); --aux-fstride K draws real windows at FRAME stride K (input = 20 frames every K-th over 20*K real frames, target = the next 20 at the same spacing) from the SAME trajs list window_index uses, so --exclude is respected by construction; same one-batch-per-real-step sampler with replacement as the sim term and the same --sim-loss full field loss at lam_aux 0.3; all five models scored in ONE compare_v9.py table so they share a band fit, --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split; seed floor 0.00 sps proxy / 0.05 full (Q3a); pre-registered: beat the relevant control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the floor without losing rel-L2
instrument_zh: 单个实验臂，--seed 1，跑 w96 L8 do45 的 400 轮配方，因此与两个对照（fno_r16_w96_do45_L8.pth 和 fno_r17_sim.pth）共享初始化，但批次顺序不同（aux 抽样与之共用同一个 CPU 随机数流）；--aux-fstride K 以帧步长 K 抽取真实窗口（输入是在 20*K 帧真实数据里每隔 K 帧取的 20 帧，目标是同样间隔的后 20 帧），索引建自 window_index 用的同一个 trajs 列表，因此 --exclude 天然被遵守；与仿真项相同的每个真实步抽一批、有放回的采样器，损失也是同一个 --sim-loss full 场损失，权重 lam_aux 0.3；五个模型放在同一张 compare_v9.py 表里评分以共享一次带宽拟合，--alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分；种子噪声下限为代理集 0.00 sps / 全划分 0.05（Q3a）；预登记判据：在两个划分上 sps 都要超过相应对照且幅度大于噪声下限，同时 rel-L2 不能变差
effect: NULL on the proxy and slightly negative on the full split. sps 43.97 against the no-sim control's 43.97 (+0.00) and 50.32 against 50.40 (-0.08, past the 0.05 floor); rel-L2 0.1063 / 0.0789 against 0.1064 / 0.0789, TKE 0.4921 / 0.5063 against 0.4929 / 0.5070, MVPE 0.0958 / 0.0706 against 0.0964 / 0.0707. Against the sim arm it is -0.33 proxy / -0.20 full. Training: field 0.03956 (+3.1 % over the no-sim control), aux 0.09414. Pool 11,448 windows.
note: THE PERTURBATION WAS REAL, WHICH IS WHY THE NULL IS INFORMATIVE. The aux term costs +3.1 % (K=2) / +3.9 % (K=3) of the training field term against sim's +4.9 %, and the aux task itself is hard -- `aux` settles at 0.094 / 0.124 against the real field's 0.040, which is what a 40-frame-ahead forecast of a 2x faster wake should cost, and it is monotone in K. So the model was perturbed by about the amount that buys sim its +0.33 and gained nothing. The 'any structured perturbation' reading of Q3d/Q3f/Q3g is FALSIFIED: those screens describe how sim delivers its value (as a regularizer -- flat in dose over 10x, insensitive to which windows it draws, growing with capacity), not what is delivered. What is delivered is CONTENT -- physics at conditions the real grid does not contain (Re 15225, Re 27975, the holes) and CFD's own dynamics -- and it cannot be synthesized from the training set. This also explains Q3g from the other side: twin-matching the mean and sigma fields removes exactly the condition-dependent content the scalar map leaves in. --aux-fstride stays in the code, inert at 0.
note_zh: 扰动是真实发生的，所以这个零结果才有信息量。aux 项让训练场损失变差 +3.1 %（K=2）/ +3.9 %（K=3），而仿真项是 +4.9 %；aux 任务本身也确实难——`aux` 稳定在 0.094 / 0.124，而真实场损失是 0.040，这正是「预测一个快 2 倍的尾流、并且要预测到 40 帧之后」应有的代价，而且随 K 单调。也就是说模型受到的扰动量级和仿真买到 +0.33 所付的代价相当，却什么也没换到。Q3d/Q3f/Q3g 引出的「任何结构化扰动都行」这一读法被证伪：那些筛选说明的是仿真如何交付价值（作为正则化项——权重变化 10 倍仍平坦、对抽到哪些窗口不敏感、随容量增长），而不是交付了什么。交付的是内容——真实网格没有的工况下的物理（Re 15225、Re 27975 以及网格空洞）以及 CFD 自身的动力学——这是无法从训练集里合成出来的。这也从另一面解释了 Q3g：用孪生轨迹匹配均值场和 sigma 场，恰好抹掉了标量映射保留下来的、依赖工况的那部分内容。--aux-fstride 保留在代码里，默认 0 时完全惰性。

arm: sim (lam 0.3, scalar map) + --aux-fstride 2 --lam-aux 0.3: do two perturbations ADD?
arm_zh: 仿真（lam 0.3，标量映射）加 --aux-fstride 2 --lam-aux 0.3：两种扰动会叠加吗？
instrument: one arm, --seed 1 on the w96 L8 do45 400-epoch recipe, so it shares its initialization with both controls (fno_r16_w96_do45_L8.pth and fno_r17_sim.pth) though not its batch order (the aux draw consumes from the same CPU generator); --aux-fstride K draws real windows at FRAME stride K (input = 20 frames every K-th over 20*K real frames, target = the next 20 at the same spacing) from the SAME trajs list window_index uses, so --exclude is respected by construction; same one-batch-per-real-step sampler with replacement as the sim term and the same --sim-loss full field loss at lam_aux 0.3; all five models scored in ONE compare_v9.py table so they share a band fit, --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split; seed floor 0.00 sps proxy / 0.05 full (Q3a); pre-registered: beat the relevant control on sps on BOTH splits by more than the floor without losing rel-L2
instrument_zh: 单个实验臂，--seed 1，跑 w96 L8 do45 的 400 轮配方，因此与两个对照（fno_r16_w96_do45_L8.pth 和 fno_r17_sim.pth）共享初始化，但批次顺序不同（aux 抽样与之共用同一个 CPU 随机数流）；--aux-fstride K 以帧步长 K 抽取真实窗口（输入是在 20*K 帧真实数据里每隔 K 帧取的 20 帧，目标是同样间隔的后 20 帧），索引建自 window_index 用的同一个 trajs 列表，因此 --exclude 天然被遵守；与仿真项相同的每个真实步抽一批、有放回的采样器，损失也是同一个 --sim-loss full 场损失，权重 lam_aux 0.3；五个模型放在同一张 compare_v9.py 表里评分以共享一次带宽拟合，--alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分；种子噪声下限为代理集 0.00 sps / 全划分 0.05（Q3a）；预登记判据：在两个划分上 sps 都要超过相应对照且幅度大于噪声下限，同时 rel-L2 不能变差
effect: NO. sps 44.23 / 50.51 against the sim arm's 44.30 / 50.52 (-0.07 / -0.01), inside the sim trio's own seed spread (0.05 proxy / 0.12 full), and no error metric moves beyond noise: rel-L2 0.1050 / 0.0780 against 0.1049 / 0.0779, TKE 0.4880 / 0.5039 against 0.4890 / 0.5041 (marginally better), MVPE 0.0960 / 0.0702 against 0.0948 / 0.0698 (marginally worse). Training: field 0.04136 (+7.8 % over the no-sim control, the largest perturbation of the round), sim 0.11747, aux 0.09848. It read the same cached scalar map every other sim arm used (92/100 phases, 17,756 windows).
verdict: inside the sim trio's spread; does not add to sim
note: THE PERTURBATION WAS REAL, WHICH IS WHY THE NULL IS INFORMATIVE. The aux term costs +3.1 % (K=2) / +3.9 % (K=3) of the training field term against sim's +4.9 %, and the aux task itself is hard -- `aux` settles at 0.094 / 0.124 against the real field's 0.040, which is what a 40-frame-ahead forecast of a 2x faster wake should cost, and it is monotone in K. So the model was perturbed by about the amount that buys sim its +0.33 and gained nothing. The 'any structured perturbation' reading of Q3d/Q3f/Q3g is FALSIFIED: those screens describe how sim delivers its value (as a regularizer -- flat in dose over 10x, insensitive to which windows it draws, growing with capacity), not what is delivered. What is delivered is CONTENT -- physics at conditions the real grid does not contain (Re 15225, Re 27975, the holes) and CFD's own dynamics -- and it cannot be synthesized from the training set. This also explains Q3g from the other side: twin-matching the mean and sigma fields removes exactly the condition-dependent content the scalar map leaves in. --aux-fstride stays in the code, inert at 0.
note_zh: 扰动是真实发生的，所以这个零结果才有信息量。aux 项让训练场损失变差 +3.1 %（K=2）/ +3.9 %（K=3），而仿真项是 +4.9 %；aux 任务本身也确实难——`aux` 稳定在 0.094 / 0.124，而真实场损失是 0.040，这正是「预测一个快 2 倍的尾流、并且要预测到 40 帧之后」应有的代价，而且随 K 单调。也就是说模型受到的扰动量级和仿真买到 +0.33 所付的代价相当，却什么也没换到。Q3d/Q3f/Q3g 引出的「任何结构化扰动都行」这一读法被证伪：那些筛选说明的是仿真如何交付价值（作为正则化项——权重变化 10 倍仍平坦、对抽到哪些窗口不敏感、随容量增长），而不是交付了什么。交付的是内容——真实网格没有的工况下的物理（Re 15225、Re 27975 以及网格空洞）以及 CFD 自身的动力学——这是无法从训练集里合成出来的。这也从另一面解释了 Q3g：用孪生轨迹匹配均值场和 sigma 场，恰好抹掉了标量映射保留下来的、依赖工况的那部分内容。--aux-fstride 保留在代码里，默认 0 时完全惰性。

arm: --sim-p-head --lam-p-sim 0.3: a TRAINING-ONLY auxiliary pressure head on sim windows (sim has p, real does not), 1x1 conv on the same trunk features head_field reads, stripped from the checkpoint at save
arm_zh: --sim-p-head --lam-p-sim 0.3：只在训练期存在的辅助压力头，监督信号来自仿真窗口（仿真有 p，真实数据没有），结构是读取 head_field 同一批主干特征的 1x1 卷积，保存时从 checkpoint 里剥离
instrument: one arm, --seed 1 on the w96 L8 do45 400-epoch sim recipe (lam_sim 0.3, scalar map, --sim-exclude-held), bit-matched to fno_r17_sim.pth in initialization -- head_p is constructed LAST in FNO2d.__init__ so it appends to the RNG stream instead of shifting every later module's draw (verified: all non-head_p tensors identical at the same seed) -- and in batch order; simreal.load_sim_mapped(with_p=True) carries sim's p as a third channel under its own `_p` cache tag (mask + speed match SQUARED, p ~ U^2, no twin amplitude step; u,v bit-identical to the 2-channel map, 26 conditions on the freestream law and 8 real trajectories withheld, exactly as every other sim arm); the p loss is the sim term's own mean/fluctuation split added to the TOTAL loss with its own weight so the `sim` column stays comparable with Q3d/f/g; head_p stripped at save and the blob re-loaded through the shipped _fno.load_any in the job itself; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 on the AoA 15-20 proxy and the full split, three models in ONE table so they share a band fit; seed floor 0.00 sps proxy / 0.05 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，跑 w96 L8 do45 的 400 轮仿真配方（lam_sim 0.3，标量映射，--sim-exclude-held），与 fno_r17_sim.pth 在初始化上逐比特匹配——head_p 在 FNO2d.__init__ 里最后构造，因此只是追加随机数流，而不会平移之后每个模块的抽样（已验证：同种子下所有非 head_p 张量完全一致）——批次顺序也一致；simreal.load_sim_mapped(with_p=True) 把仿真的 p 作为第三个通道，用独立的 `_p` 缓存标签（掩膜加速度匹配因子的平方，因为 p ~ U^2，不做孪生幅度缩放；u,v 与两通道映射逐比特相同，26 个工况走自由来流定律、8 条真实轨迹被排除在孪生表之外，与其他所有仿真臂完全一致）；p 损失沿用仿真项自己的均值/脉动拆分，以独立权重加到总损失上，这样 `sim` 这一列仍可与 Q3d/f/g 对比；保存时剥离 head_p，并在作业内用出货用的 _fno.load_any 重新载入验证；compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39 跑代理集和全划分，三个模型放在同一张表里共享带宽拟合；种子下限代理集 0.00 sps / 全划分 0.05
effect: NULL on sps: 44.30 against the sim control's 44.30 on the proxy, 50.50 against 50.52 on the full split. rel-L2 0.1049 / 0.0778 against 0.1049 / 0.0779; MVPE 0.0949 / 0.0696 against 0.0948 / 0.0698. TKE is the only consistent direction -- 0.4868 / 0.5030 against 0.4890 / 0.5041, -0.45 % / -0.22 % -- and both are inside the seed floor; wfinal +0.009 / +0.001. THE HEAD WAS EXPENSIVE AND THE TARGET WAS FREE: the real field term cost +10.4 % (0.04443 against 0.04026, more than twice the whole sim term's +4.9 % over the no-sim control), the sim term itself +9.9 % (0.12632 against 0.11496), var +4.5 % and tke +7.2 %, for psim = 0.00873 -- the head explained 99.1 % of the pooled p variance
verdict: null; pooled p normalization is Re²-dominated — weak test
note: THIS IS A WEAK TEST, NOT A CLEAN NULL, AND THE CAVEAT WAS PRE-REGISTERED. The speed match enters pressure as sc^2 ~ Re^2, so with ONE pooled normalizer (mean 0.0285, std 0.3907) the pooled variance is almost entirely BETWEEN conditions. Measured from the same cached map by the follow-up job: the mean per-trajectory p std is 0.0211, 18.5x below the pooled value, and the per-trajectory stds span 4,382x (0.000281 .. 1.232) -- a weight ratio of ~2e6 between the extreme conditions in a pooled MSE. So the head learned mostly 'how fast is this condition', which the input window already says, and the pressure FIELD at mid and low Re was effectively unsupervised. What is measured here is that a pressure head trained on an amplitude-dominated target costs 10 % of the field fit and returns nothing; whether pressure STRUCTURE is content the velocity channels lack is still unmeasured. Q3k (--sim-p-norm traj, lam_p_sim 0.1, job 7173795) is the proper test and the LAST sim-content arm. Everything else about the build stands: the `_p` map, the save-time strip (the blob loads through _fno.load_any with 0 head_p keys), and the verified bit-identity of the default path.
note_zh: 这是一次弱测试，而不是干净的零结果，而且这个隐患是事先登记过的。速度匹配作用在压力上是平方关系 sc^2 ~ Re^2，所以用单一池化归一化（均值 0.0285，标准差 0.3907）时，池化方差几乎全部来自工况之间的差异。后续作业从同一份缓存映射里测得：逐轨迹 p 标准差的平均值是 0.0211，比池化值小 18.5 倍，而逐轨迹标准差跨度达 4,382 倍（0.000281 到 1.232）——在池化 MSE 里，极端工况之间的权重比约为 2e6。因此这个头学到的主要是「这个工况有多快」，而输入窗口本来就写着这一点，中低雷诺数下的压力场实际上没有得到监督。这里真正测到的是：在一个被幅度主导的目标上训练压力头，会付出 10 % 的场拟合代价而一无所获；至于压力的结构是不是速度通道所缺少的内容，仍然没有被测量。Q3k（--sim-p-norm traj，lam_p_sim 0.1，作业 7173795）才是正确的测试，也是最后一个仿真内容臂。这次构建的其余部分都成立：`_p` 映射、保存时的剥离（blob 能通过 _fno.load_any 载入，且 head_p 键为 0），以及已验证的默认路径逐比特一致。

arm: --sim-p-head --sim-p-norm traj --lam-p-sim 0.1: the auxiliary pressure head again, with the p target standardized PER TRAJECTORY so every condition contributes equally -- the clean version of the Q3j test
arm_zh: --sim-p-head --sim-p-norm traj --lam-p-sim 0.1：再做一次辅助压力头，但把 p 目标按每条轨迹各自标准化，使每个工况的贡献相同——这是 Q3j 那次测试的干净版本
instrument: one arm, --seed 1 on the w96 L8 do45 400-epoch sim recipe, bit-matched in initialization to both fno_r17_sim.pth and fno_r17_simp.pth (head_p is built last in FNO2d.__init__); cache HIT on Q3j's 2.46 GB `_p` map, so the same 17,756 sim windows at stride 5 and the same leak-free 26-on-the-law map; per-trajectory mean/std computed in memory from that cached array and gathered per batch from column 0 of sim_idx; lambda cut 0.3 -> 0.1 because removing the amplitude shortcut raises the term's scale by ~16x, so 0.1 is still a BIGGER p gradient than Q3j applied; head_p stripped at save and the blob re-loaded through the shipped _fno.load_any inside the job; compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39, four models in ONE table so they share a band fit, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split; seed floor 0.00 sps proxy / 0.05 full
instrument_zh: 单臂，--seed 1，跑 w96 L8 do45 的 400 轮仿真配方，与 fno_r17_sim.pth 和 fno_r17_simp.pth 在初始化上都逐比特匹配（head_p 在 FNO2d.__init__ 中最后构造）；命中 Q3j 建好的 2.46 GB `_p` 缓存映射，因此是同样的 17,756 个步长 5 仿真窗口、同样无泄漏的「26 个工况走定律」映射；逐轨迹均值/标准差直接在内存里从该缓存数组算出，并按 sim_idx 第 0 列逐批索引；权重从 0.3 降到 0.1，因为去掉幅度捷径后该项的量级会升高约 16 倍，所以 0.1 施加的压力梯度其实仍比 Q3j 更大；保存时剥离 head_p，并在作业内用出货用的 _fno.load_any 重新载入验证；compare_v9.py --alpha 0.60 --inflate 1.39，四个模型同表共享带宽拟合，跑 AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分；种子下限 代理集 0.00 sps / 全划分 0.05
effect: NULL by the drop rule, and the ONE thing it moves is TKE. sps 44.29 proxy (-0.01 against the sim control) and 50.57 full (+0.05, exactly the seed floor). TKE 0.4861 / 0.5018 against 0.4890 / 0.5041 -- -0.59 % / -0.46 %, the round's best L8 TKE on both splits, below even the pooled-p arm's 0.4868 / 0.5030. rel-L2 splits (0.1052 proxy, +0.29 %; 0.0777 full, -0.26 %) and MVPE is flat to slightly better (0.0945 / 0.0696). wfinal 82.647 / 84.872 -- the best full-split wfinal of the four. THE TEST WAS CLEAN, which is the point: psim falls 3.580 -> 0.208 (ep 100) -> 0.162 (200) -> 0.138 (399) against Q3j's 0.00873, i.e. 16x higher with no amplitude shortcut left, and it cost the real field term only +1.4 % (0.04084 against 0.04026) against Q3j's +10.4 %
effect_zh: 按淘汰规则是零结果，而它唯一推动的是 TKE。代理集 sps 44.29（相对仿真对照 -0.01），全划分 50.57（+0.05，正好等于种子下限）。TKE 0.4861 / 0.5018 对 0.4890 / 0.5041，即 -0.59 % / -0.46 %，是本轮两个划分上最好的 L8 TKE，甚至优于池化 p 那一臂的 0.4868 / 0.5030。rel-L2 结果分歧（代理集 0.1052，+0.29 %；全划分 0.0777，-0.26 %），MVPE 持平略好（0.0945 / 0.0696）。wfinal 82.647 / 84.872——全划分上是四者中最好的。关键在于这次测试是干净的：psim 从 3.580 降到 0.208（第 100 轮）、0.162（200）、0.138（399），而 Q3j 是 0.00873，也就是高出 16 倍且再没有幅度捷径可走；而它对真实场损失的代价只有 +1.4 %（0.04084 对 0.04026），Q3j 是 +10.4 %
verdict: null on sps (floor); TKE −0.5 %; pressure closed
note: PRESSURE IS CONTENT THE TRUNK CAN USE, AND IT IS WORTH ALMOST NOTHING TO THE SCORED FIELDS -- a stronger statement than Q3j's null, because this test was clean. A 0.5 % TKE cut prices at ~+0.08 tke_score ~ +0.01 final before ensemble dilution. THE SIM LINE IS NOW CLOSED IN EVERY DIRECTION: content (conditions and dynamics: YES, +0.33 / +0.15 sps at L8, Q3a's 3-vs-3 gate), dose (flat over 10x, Q3d), diversity (flat over 2.5x, Q3f), faithfulness (INVERTED, Q3g), capacity (tie at 4 fp16 members, Q3e), mixed ensembles (nothing, Q3h), real-data perturbation (null, Q3i), pressure (here). What ships is unchanged: four all-data w96 L8 do45 members co-trained at lam_sim 0.3 with the scalar map. ONE OPEN NOTE, NOT AN ACTION: the only two arms that moved TKE and nothing else were capacity-with-sim (simw128, -1.1 % per model) and per-trajectory pressure (-0.5 %); both are priced out today -- the first by members, the second by sps-neutrality -- and they are the levers to reach for if a future round needs TKE specifically. Q3 cost 64.78 GPU-h over twelve jobs; the round's ledger totals 90.63.
note_zh: 压力确实是主干能够利用的内容，但它对被评分的场几乎毫无价值——这个结论比 Q3j 的零结果更强，因为这次测试是干净的。0.5 % 的 TKE 改进折算约为 +0.08 tke_score，约 +0.01 final，还没算集成稀释。至此仿真这条线在每个方向上都已关闭：内容（工况与动力学：是的，L8 上 +0.33 / +0.15 sps，Q3a 的三对三门槛）、剂量（10 倍范围内平坦，Q3d）、多样性（2.5 倍范围内平坦，Q3f）、保真度（反向，Q3g）、容量（4 个 fp16 成员下打平，Q3e）、混合集成（无收益，Q3h）、真实数据扰动（零，Q3i）、压力（本次）。出货方案不变：四个全数据 w96 L8 do45 成员，以 lam_sim 0.3 加标量映射协同训练。留一条备注而非行动项：本轮唯一只推动 TKE 的两个臂是带仿真的容量（simw128，单模型 -1.1 %）和逐轨迹压力（-0.5 %）；两者今天都不划算——前者受成员数限制，后者因为 sps 中性——但如果未来某一轮专门需要 TKE，就该从这两个杠杆入手。Q3 共花费 64.78 GPU-h，分十二个作业；本轮账本合计 90.63。

arm: BOARD LATENCY SLOPE, re-measured by two bit-identical A/B rounds (R18 HOST_WRITE=torch, T2R6 SPEC_PATH=bmm)
arm_zh: 用两轮逐位相同的 A/B（R18 的 HOST_WRITE=torch、T2R6 的 SPEC_PATH=bmm）重新测量 board 的延迟斜率
instrument: two board rounds whose four error subscores came back identical, so `time` is the only thing that moved; plus a refit of board ms on local ms over the eleven one-invocation rounds

effect: BOTH LATENCY ARMS UNDER-DELIVERED BY 3x OR MORE. R17->R18: local -0.352 4060-eq ms, predicted -0.283 board ms, ACTUAL -0.089, slope +0.25. T2R5->T2R6: local -0.890, predicted -0.810, ACTUAL +0.039, slope -0.04. T2R3->T2R5 (8xL4 -> 4xL8, the batch-1 step nearly doubled): +2.353 local for +0.114 board, slope +0.05. Refitting the eleven one-invocation rounds: board ms = 3.274 + 0.336*local, rms 0.337 ms, where the round-13 model (4.447 + 0.324*inv + 0.431*local) misses every one of them by 1.3-2.5 ms
effect_zh: 两个延迟臂都少交付了 3 倍以上。R17->R18：本地 -0.352 4060 等效毫秒，预测 board -0.283 ms，实际 -0.089，斜率 +0.25。T2R5->T2R6：本地 -0.890，预测 -0.810，实际 +0.039，斜率 -0.04。T2R3->T2R5（8xL4 换成 4xL8，batch-1 单步几乎翻倍）：本地 +2.353 只换来 board +0.114，斜率 +0.05。对 11 个单次调用轮次重新拟合：board ms = 3.274 + 0.336*local，rms 0.337 ms；而第 13 轮的模型（4.447 + 0.324*inv + 0.431*local）对其中每一轮都差 1.3–2.5 ms
verdict: CLOSED: latency work is done; members are nearly free
note: The consequence is NOT 'latency is free', it is 'MEMBERS ARE NEARLY FREE'. Round 17's Q1f priced 4 -> 8 members at +0.086 of accuracy against a 0.09-0.10 latency bill using the 0.803 slope; at 0.336 the bill is 0.037 on Track 1 and ~0 on Track 2, so the same step is worth +0.05 / +0.09. What blocks it is the 256 MB extracted cap and nothing else. Also: w_time now has THREE direct single-subscore readings -- 0.09559 / 0.09580 / 0.09589 -- inside 0.3 % of each other
note_zh: 推论不是「延迟免费」，而是「成员几乎免费」。第 17 轮的 Q1f 用 0.803 的斜率把 4 -> 8 成员定价为 +0.086 的精度换 0.09–0.10 的延迟账单；在 0.336 下这份账单在 Track 1 只有 0.037、在 Track 2 约为 0，于是同一步值 +0.05 / +0.09。挡住它的只有 256 MB 的解压上限。另外：w_time 现在有三次直接的单子分读数——0.09559 / 0.09580 / 0.09589——彼此相差不到 0.3 %
