Per tensor 3.0e-2, per out-channel 1.7e-2, per Fourier mode 3.0e-2 -- 20-40x worse, none shippable. END TO END at EIGHT members: 232.0 MB extracted (cap 256), prediction difference rel-L2 3.9e-4 (BETTER than a single member, because the quantization noise is independent across members and averages down), rel_l2 +0.0002 %, tke -0.04 %, mvpe -0.03 %
effect_zh: 只有「每个 (out, in) 通道对一个 scale」这一档可用，更粗的都不行：场差的 rel-L2 为 8.3e-4，每成员 29.0 MB；对比 fp16 的 2.7e-4 / 56.9 MB，以及模型自身 0.077 的 rel-L2。逐张量 3.0e-2、逐输出通道 1.7e-2、逐傅里叶模态 3.0e-2——差 20–40 倍，都不能上线。八成员端到端：解压 232.0 MB（上限 256），预测差 rel-L2 3.9e-4（比单成员还小，因为量化噪声在成员间独立、会被平均掉），rel_l2 +0.0002 %、tke -0.04 %、mvpe -0.03 %
verdict: INT8 PACKING OK -- eight w96 L8 members fit
note: This is the enabling half of the latency finding: the member count is now limited by bytes, and int8 buys the factor of two that fp16 already bought once. The packer lives in _fno.pack_state_dict so build_zip.py and Track_2/build_t2.py cannot drift apart, and dequant8 is a no-op on every checkpoint written before it existed
note_zh: 这是延迟结论能落地的另一半：成员数现在受字节数限制，而 int8 又买回了 fp16 曾经买到的那个 2 倍。打包器放在 _fno.pack_state_dict 里，使 build_zip.py 与 Track_2/build_t2.py 不会各自漂移；dequant8 对此前写下的任何检查点都是空操作

arm: THE SPS INTERVAL NEED NOT BE CENTRED ON THE PREDICTION: a per-element centre shift, plus the exact asymmetric ceiling
arm_zh: SPS 的区间不必以预测为中心：逐元素中心偏移，以及精确的非对称上界
instrument: band_shift_v9.py on three held-out do45 L8 twins, AoA 15-20, inflate 1.39, band-p 0.45, smooth 3; the ceiling solves max over ALL pairs of observed signed errors per element; the deployable shift is selected by leave-one-TRAJECTORY-out CV inside the fitting split
instrument_zh: band_shift_v9.py，三个留出的 do45 L8 孪生模型，AoA 15-20，inflate 1.39，band-p 0.45，平滑 3；上界是对每个元素在所有有符号误差对上取最大；可部署的偏移则用拟合划分内部的留一轨迹交叉验证来选
effect: THERE IS NO SYSTEMATIC PER-ELEMENT BIAS TO EXPLOIT. |mean(E)|/std(E) has median 0.100 against the 0.089 that pure sampling noise gives at n = 126 (p90 0.297, only 2.7 % above 0.5). The exact asymmetric in-sample ceiling is +0.809 sps over the exact symmetric one; the CV-selected shift (k = 9, scale 0.75) delivers +0.041 sps out of sample -- 5 % of the ceiling, i.e. the ceiling is overfitting. +0.010 final
effect_zh: 没有可利用的系统性逐元素偏差。|mean(E)|/std(E) 的中位数是 0.100，而 n = 126 时纯采样噪声就给出 0.089（p90 为 0.297，只有 2.7 % 超过 0.5）。精确非对称的样本内上界比精确对称高 +0.809 sps；交叉验证选出的偏移（k = 9，scale 0.75）在样本外只兑现 +0.041 sps——是上界的 5 %，也就是说那个上界是过拟合。折合 +0.010 final
verdict: CLOSED -- the band, for the fifth time, now in the asymmetric family
note: Legal and free by construction: aggregate_sps requires only finite, same-shape, lower <= upper, and the per-sample factor a_i is computed from the PREDICTION array, so an off-centre band moves `sps` alone and leaves rel_l2, tke and mvpe bit-identical. That is what made it worth one debug-queue job. The four earlier band closures (rounds 6, 10b, 11, 13) all searched the SYMMETRIC family only
note_zh: 它在构造上既合法又免费：aggregate_sps 只要求边界有限、形状相同、lower <= upper，而逐样本因子 a_i 是从预测数组算出来的，所以偏心的区间只动 `sps`，rel_l2、tke、mvpe 逐位不变。正因如此才值得花一个 debug 队列作业。此前四次 band 封闭（第 6、10b、11、13 轮）搜索的都只是对称族

arm: the post-hoc battery: zero-painting from the input's own all-zero mask, clamping to the input envelope, per-element MEDIAN instead of MEAN, a per-lead-time ALPHA ramp, a persistence blend
arm_zh: 后验变换组合拳：用输入自身的全零掩码涂零、把预测夹到输入包络内、逐元素取中位数而非均值、随预测步长变化的 ALPHA 斜坡、以及向持续性预测的混合
instrument: posthoc_v9.py on three held-out do45 L8 twins, every transform scored with the band REFITTED on it (val_seen AoA 15-20, inflate 1.39, band-p 0.45, smooth 3) and reported on both views of val_unseen
instrument_zh: posthoc_v9.py，三个留出的 do45 L8 孪生模型；每种变换都按它自己重新拟合 band（val_seen 的 AoA 15-20，inflate 1.39，band-p 0.45，平滑 3），再在 val_unseen 的两个视图上报告
effect: ALL NULL OR NEGATIVE. Zero-painting: 9.95 % of target u,v elements are exactly 0 and the mask is recoverable from window k's OWN input at 98.9 % agreement (8.63 % of pixel-channels zero through all 20 input frames vs 8.63 % through all 20 target frames, 7,563 false positives against 7,568 false negatives) -- and painting it on changes rel-L2 by 0.00000 at five decimals at every threshold from 0 to 1e-3, because the model already predicts ~0 there. Clamping to the input window's envelope: full-split rel-L2 0.0771 -> 0.0897 at k = 0 and still 0.0777 at k = 2, strongly negative. Median: 0.0774 / sps 45.08 against the mean's 0.0771 / 45.17. ALPHA ramp 0.40->0.80: +0.003 wfinal proxy, -0.023 full. Persistence blend: monotone worse past b0 = 0.1
effect_zh: 全部为零或为负。涂零：目标 u,v 中恰好为 0 的元素占 9.95 %，而这个掩码可以从窗口 k 自己的输入中以 98.9 % 的一致性还原（8.63 % 的像素-通道在全部 20 帧输入中为零，对应 8.63 % 在全部 20 帧目标中为零，7,563 个假阳对 7,568 个假阴）——但把它涂上去，从阈值 0 到 1e-3，rel-L2 在五位小数上都是 0.00000，因为模型本来就在那里预测约 0。夹到输入包络内：全划分 rel-L2 从 0.0771 变成 k = 0 时的 0.0897，k = 2 时仍有 0.0777，明显为负。中位数：0.0774 / sps 45.08，对均值的 0.0771 / 45.17。ALPHA 斜坡 0.40->0.80：代理集 wfinal +0.003，全划分 -0.023。持续性混合：越过 b0 = 0.1 后单调变差
verdict: CLOSED -- the post-hoc family is exhausted
note: Everything that can be done to the prediction array AFTER the model has run has now been tried and is worth <= +0.01. The value has to come from the members and from the objective. Also measured here: rho on the shipped recipe is 0.809 in-sample -> 0.631 held-out (round 14 had 0.609 on w24 L4), so capacity moved it a little and the remaining gap is generalization
note_zh: 凡是能在模型跑完之后对预测数组做的事，现在都试过了，价值都不超过 +0.01。收益必须来自成员数和目标函数。这里同时测到：现役配方的 rho 样本内 0.809、留出 0.631（第 14 轮在 w24 L4 上是 0.609），说明容量确实推动了一点，剩下的差距属于泛化

arm: MC DROPOUT as a zero-storage ensemble: leave Dropout2d in train mode at inference and average N stochastic passes
arm_zh: 把 MC dropout 当作零存储成本的集成：推理时让 Dropout2d 保持训练模式，对 N 次随机前向取平均
instrument: mcdrop_v9.py; the shipped predict_fno averages members in raw-field and sigma space before compose, so passing one model N times IS the deployed ensemble path. One w96 L8 do45 checkpoint at N = 1/2/4/8/16, then the three-member trio at N = 1/2/4
instrument_zh: mcdrop_v9.py；已上线的 predict_fno 是在原始场和 sigma 空间里先对成员取平均、再做 compose，所以把同一个模型传 N 次，走的就是部署时那条集成路径。先用一个 w96 L8 do45 检查点跑 N = 1/2/4/8/16，再用三成员组合跑 N = 1/2/4
effect: MONOTONE CONVERGENCE TO THE DETERMINISTIC MODEL FROM BELOW, NEVER ACROSS IT. Full split, one checkpoint: deterministic sps 43.46; MC x1 42.02, x2 42.78, x4 43.11, x8 43.31, x16 43.39 -- still -0.019 final at sixteen passes. On the real trio: -0.259 / -0.170 / -0.087 at N = 1/2/4. Every error metric shows the same shape
effect_zh: 从下方单调收敛到确定性模型，而且从未越过它。全划分、单个检查点：确定性 sps 43.46；MC x1 为 42.02，x2 42.78，x4 43.11，x8 43.31，x16 43.39——跑到十六次前向仍然是 -0.019 final。在真实三成员组合上，N = 1/2/4 分别是 -0.259 / -0.170 / -0.087。每个误差指标都是同一个形状
verdict: CLOSED -- dropout at inference is strictly worse than the weight-scaled deterministic pass
note: The deterministic forward IS the first-order average over dropout masks (that is what weight scaling means), so MC sampling can only add variance the averaging then has to remove. Worth running because it was the one way to add ensemble diversity at ZERO archive cost, and round 18 had just made the 256 MB cap the binding constraint
note_zh: 确定性前向本身就是对所有 dropout 掩码的一阶平均（权重缩放的含义正是如此），所以 MC 采样只能引入方差，再由平均去消掉。之所以值得一跑，是因为它是唯一能在零存档开销下增加集成多样性的办法，而第 18 轮刚把 256 MB 上限变成了绑定约束

arm: the EIGHT-MEMBER int8 package: is doubling the member count worth a slot?
arm_zh: 八成员 int8 包：把成员数翻倍值不值一个提交名额？
instrument: build_round13.sh with --int8 (scales per (out, in) channel pair), 4x do45 + 4x do30 all-data w96 L8, band refitted on six held-out twins; priced with predict_board.py against the ACTUAL T2R6 result
instrument_zh: build_round13.sh 加 --int8（按 (out, in) 通道对给缩放因子），4 个 do45 加 4 个 do30 的全数据 w96 L8，band 在六个留出孪生模型上重新拟合；用 predict_board.py 对着 T2R6 的实际结果定价
effect: A WASH: accuracy +0.038 against a latency bill of -0.041, net -0.003. rel +0.020, tke +0.062, mvpe +0.023, sps +0.081, time -0.427. The K-curve e(K) = e_inf + c/K was RIGHT (4 -> 8 is +0.041 of accuracy) and its consequence inverts, because local 2.45 -> 4.30 ms is +0.62 board ms at the refit 0.336 slope
effect_zh: 打平：精度 +0.038，延迟账单 -0.041，净值 -0.003。rel +0.020，tke +0.062，mvpe +0.023，sps +0.081，time -0.427。K 曲线 e(K) = e_inf + c/K 是对的（4 到 8 值 +0.041 的精度），但结论反了，因为本地 2.45 到 4.30 ms 在重新拟合出的 0.336 斜率下就是 +0.62 板上毫秒
verdict: NOT SUBMITTED -- member count does not get a slot
note: The earlier +0.039 reading was WRONG and the reason is worth keeping: build_round13.sh exited 1 on its idle-GPU guard, so Track_2/submit/band8.npz still held the SIM package's band, and the next line copied it into the pricing without noticing (md5 2d444bab..., byte-for-byte band_r17_simx4.npz). A build step that exits non-zero must not leave its outputs readable by the steps after it. The honest thing int8 DOES buy is a BIGGER member, not a fifth one: w128 L8 is 51 MB int8 so four fit, w160 L8 is 79 MB so three fit, where fp16 allows two and one. ROUND 23 RE-READS THE LATENCY HALF: 8 fused members is still ONE invocation, so the -0.041 came entirely from the local-ms term -- and round 23 showed the board is LAUNCH-bound, not FLOP-bound (4 sequential forwards cost +3.45 board ms over 1 grouped forward at the same FLOPs). A change that adds FLOPs without adding calls may therefore be cheaper than the 0.336 slope says, which would make 4 -> 8 net POSITIVE at +0.038 instead of a wash. Not resolved; the honest state is 'the accuracy side is +0.038 and the bill is somewhere in [0, 0.041]'
note_zh: 之前读到的 +0.039 是错的，而错因值得记下来：build_round13.sh 在空闲 GPU 守卫处退出 1，于是 Track_2/submit/band8.npz 里仍是 sim 包的 band，下一行毫无察觉地把它抄进了定价（md5 2d444bab...，与 band_r17_simx4.npz 逐字节相同）。一个以非零状态退出的构建步骤，绝不能把自己的输出留给后续步骤读取。int8 真正买到的是更大的成员，而不是第五个成员：w128 L8 int8 是 51 MB，四个能装下；w160 L8 是 79 MB，三个能装下；而 fp16 下分别只能装两个和一个。第 23 轮重读了延迟这一半：八个融合成员仍然只有一次调用，所以那 -0.041 完全来自本地毫秒项——而第 23 轮表明板上是受 kernel launch 限制的，不是受 FLOPs 限制的（同样的 FLOPs，四次顺序前向比一次 grouped 前向贵 3.45 板上毫秒）。因此只加 FLOPs 不加调用次数的改动，可能比 0.336 斜率说的便宜，那样 4 到 8 就是净 +0.038 而不是打平

arm: `sps` FACTORIZES: a per-sample factor a_i times a containment term
arm_zh: `sps` 可分解：per-sample 因子 a_i 乘含盖率项
instrument: sps = 100 * mean_i(a_i) * (weighted containment) with a_i = 0.5g(rel)+0.3g(tke)+0.2g(mvpe); price a step as sps(A) * a(B)/a(A) from published subscores only -- no free parameter, no local measurement. predict_board.py --sps-selftest, all 18 consecutive board pairs
instrument_zh: sps = 100 * mean_i(a_i) * (加权含盖率)，a_i = 0.5g(rel)+0.3g(tke)+0.2g(mvpe)；一步的定价只用已公布的子分数：sps(A) * a(B)/a(A)，没有自由参数，也不需要任何本地测量。predict_board.py --sps-selftest，18 对连续 board 步骤
effect: THE RESIDUAL IS THE CONTAINMENT TERM, and sorted by |residual| it gives the COMPLETE list of what has ever moved it: the BAND (+1.410, R9->R10), regularized CAPACITY (+0.992/+0.961, w24->w96 on both boards), MEMBER COUNT (+0.668, 3->8), and the architecture FAMILY (+0.464/-0.440, U-FNO in and back out). Everything rounds 16-19 tried -- sim, depth at equal FLOPs, the coverage and temporal-gradient losses, lam_v, both latency rebuilds, the gated blend -- lands inside +-0.05. From R13 on the model is exact to a median of 0.026 sps (+-0.007 final) precisely BECAUSE band, members and family have been frozen since R13.
effect_zh: 残差就是含盖率项。按 |残差| 排序，它给出历史上动过含盖率的完整清单：band（+1.410，R9→R10）、带正则的容量（+0.992/+0.961，w24→w96，两块板都复现）、成员数（+0.668，3→8）、架构家族（+0.464/−0.440，U-FNO 进再出）。第 16–19 轮试过的一切——sim、等 FLOPs 的深度、coverage 与 temporal-gradient 损失、lam_v、两次延迟重构、门控混合——全在 ±0.05 内。从 R13 起模型精确到中位 0.026 sps（±0.007 final），正是因为 band、成员数、家族自 R13 起就冻住了。
note: It also re-prices the exchange rate, because a_i is computed from the other three subscores and their effect on sps needs no local measurement. Per 10 % of error removed, containment held fixed: rel_l2 +0.346 (was +0.238), tke +0.290 (was +0.175), mvpe +0.100 (was +0.053). tke is worth 84 % of rel_l2, not 74 %.
note_zh: 它也重新给兑换率定价：a_i 由另外三个子分数决定，它们经 sps 的影响不需要任何本地测量。按住含盖率，每削减 10 % 误差：rel_l2 +0.346（原 +0.238）、tke +0.290（原 +0.175）、mvpe +0.100（原 +0.053）。tke 值 rel_l2 的 84 %，不是 74 %。

arm: width 160 at the shipping recipe -- the capacity lever, retested at ensemble size
arm_zh: 上线配方下的宽度 160——容量杠杆，在集成规模下重测
instrument: three held-out w160 L8 cmb3sim seeds, 3-vs-3 against the w96 trio with the band refit per set; gate threshold ~+0.5 full-split ensemble sps, calibrated from R15's own local reading (+0.87 full against a board +1.013)
instrument_zh: 三颗留出的 w160 L8 cmb3sim 种子，与 w96 三重奏做 3-vs-3、band 各自重拟合；闸门阈值约 +0.5 full-split 集成 sps，由 R15 自己的本地读数标定（本地 +0.87 对板上 +1.013）
effect: FAILS THE GATE. Full-split sps 44.31 -> 44.31 (zero), proxy 37.70 -> 37.56 (WORSE), rel-L2 worse on both splits. Note the trap it walks into: PER MODEL w160 is better (full sps 50.73 / 50.68 / 50.69 against 50.52 / 50.53 / 50.51, +0.18) and the gain vanishes entirely at ensemble size -- the fifth arm in this project to do that. The capacity ladder is now closed at w96 L8 with the shipping recipe, ensemble-tested, against a calibrated threshold.
effect_zh: 没过闸门。full-split sps 44.31 → 44.31（零），proxy 37.70 → 37.56（更差），rel-L2 两个划分都更差。注意它踩的陷阱：单模型层面 w160 是更好的（full sps 50.73/50.68/50.69 对 50.52/50.53/50.51，+0.18），集成后收益完全消失——这是本项目第五个这样的实验。容量阶梯现在在 w96 L8 上封闭：上线配方、集成验证、标定过的阈值。
note: It also kills the int8-for-a-bigger-member argument. int8 was verified on CPU first: a w160 L8 member packs to 80.34 MB so three fit 241.0 MB against fp16's 473.6, and the quantization perturbs the field by rel-L2 2.0e-3, ~1.7 % of a median half-width. The packing works; there is nothing worth packing.
note_zh: 它也否掉了「用 int8 换更大成员」这条理由。int8 先在 CPU 上验过：一个 w160 L8 成员打包成 80.34 MB，三个共 241.0 MB（fp16 要 473.6），量化对场的扰动是 rel-L2 2.0e-3，约中位半宽的 1.7 %。打包是好的，只是没有值得打包的东西。

arm: the variance head, reopened at the current operating point
arm_zh: 方差头，在当前工作点重开
instrument: --var-deep (concat(h1..h8): 768 trunk channels against round 11's 96 at L4), --var-hidden 256, --var-in-std, and --var-pred-std -- the one round 11 WROTE, verified bit-exact through fuse(), and then cancelled without ever running. All four on w96 L8 do45 cmb3sim with --seed 1, bit-matched to fno_r18_cmb3sim.pth
instrument_zh: --var-deep（concat(h1..h8)：768 个主干通道，第 11 轮在 L4 上只有 96）、--var-hidden 256、--var-in-std，以及 --var-pred-std——第 11 轮写了代码、验过 fuse() 逐位一致、然后从未运行就取消的那个。四个臂都在 w96 L8 do45 cmb3sim 上、--seed 1 与 fno_r18_cmb3sim.pth 逐位对齐
effect: ALL FOUR NULL. Training `var` 0.34733 (control) -> 0.34399 / 0.34474 / -- / --, so two arms did move it, slightly. Full-split sps 50.52 -> 50.57 / 50.55 / 50.45 / 50.45, all inside the seed floor. --var-pred-std, the never-run one, is the WORST of the four on TKE (0.5069 against the control's 0.5036), so round 11's cancellation was correct. Round 11's information floor replicates at capacity, with dropout and with sim.
effect_zh: 四个全空。训练 `var` 0.34733（对照）→ 0.34399 / 0.34474 / — / —，其中两个臂确实动了，但很小。full-split sps 50.52 → 50.57 / 50.55 / 50.45 / 50.45，全在种子噪声内。--var-pred-std 这个从没跑过的，在 TKE 上是四个里最差的（0.5069 对对照的 0.5036），所以第 11 轮的取消判断是对的。第 11 轮的信息上限在带 dropout 和 sim 的 w96 L8 上复现了。
note: Worth reopening only because round 11 measured all three of its arms on w24 / L4 / no dropout / 150 epochs -- the model round 14 later showed could not fit even eight memorized trajectories (rho 0.588). CLAUDE.md drew that consequence for the data-side nulls and never drew it for the sigma head. Now it has been drawn, and the answer is the same.
note_zh: 值得重开只因为第 11 轮那三个臂全是在 w24 / L4 / 无 dropout / 150 轮上测的——也就是第 14 轮后来证明连八条记住的轨迹都拟合不了的那个模型（rho 0.588）。CLAUDE.md 对数据侧的空结果下了这个推论，却从没对方差头下过。现在下了，答案一样。

arm: the far-tail screen, calibrated against the one known positive
arm_zh: 远尾筛选，用唯一已知的正例做标定
instrument: tail_map_v9.py's TAIL SUMMARY (a_i-weighted fraction of scored elements with |E| > 2h and > 3h) on R15's own w24 -> w96 step, replayed through the identical instrument as every round-18/19 arm
instrument_zh: tail_map_v9.py 的 TAIL SUMMARY（|E| > 2h 与 > 3h 的 a_i 加权已评分元素占比）用在 R15 自己的 w24 → w96 那一步上，走的是与第 18/19 轮每个臂完全相同的仪器
effect: THE SCREEN SEES R15 AND OVER-READS EVERYTHING ELSE BY ~6x. R15: miss -1.38 pp, |E|>2h -0.29 pp, board containment +0.99. cmb3sim: -0.37 pp / -0.08 pp, i.e. 27-28 % of an R15 on both columns -- which would forecast +0.27 sps of containment, and the board delivered +0.049. sim: -0.10 pp, board 0.00. So the mapping is threshold-like, not linear: only very large tail moves count, and the screen is a SIGN, like local sps. Meanwhile every arm of rounds 18-19 spans just 0.09 pp on |E|>2h -- capacity, dropout, sim dose, the coverage loss, lam_v, tgrad all leave the same elements the same distance outside.
effect_zh: 这把尺子看得见 R15，对其余一切高估约 6 倍。R15：miss −1.38 pp、|E|>2h −0.29 pp，板上含盖率 +0.99。cmb3sim：−0.37 / −0.08，两列都是 R15 的 27–28 %——线性外推会预测 +0.27 sps 的含盖率，而板上给了 +0.049。sim：−0.10 pp，板上 0.00。所以这个映射是阈值型而非线性的：只有很大的尾部移动才算数，这把尺子和本地 sps 一样只是符号。与此同时第 18/19 轮每个臂在 |E|>2h 上的跨度只有 0.09 pp——容量、dropout、sim 剂量、coverage loss、lam_v、tgrad 全都把同一批元素留在同样远的地方。

arm: cross-family diversity WITHOUT the member the board punished
arm_zh: 跨家族多样性，不带那个被板上罚过的成员
instrument: ens_v9.py 3-vs-3 and 4-member sets, band refit per set, held-out, both splits: cmb3sim x3 against U-FNO+ViT+AFNO, ViT+AFNO+cmb3sim, and all four families
instrument_zh: ens_v9.py 的 3-vs-3 与四成员组合，band 各自重拟合，留出集，两个划分：cmb3sim x3 对 U-FNO+ViT+AFNO、ViT+AFNO+cmb3sim，以及四家族全上
effect: 69 % OF THE CROSS-FAMILY GAIN SURVIVES WITHOUT U-FNO. Full split, sps: cmb3sim x3 44.31, ViT+AFNO+cmb3sim 44.68 (+0.37), U-FNO+ViT+AFNO 44.85 (+0.54), all four 44.90 (+0.59); rel-L2 0.0762 -> 0.0747 / 0.0744 / 0.0742 and TKE and MVPE follow. Round 16 closed the family lever on U-FNO x3's -0.45 board miss, which was true of the PACKAGE (time -0.207 at batch 1, rel_l2 +1.9 %) and false of the MEMBER -- its +0.44 sps was the third-largest containment move on record. Four cmb3sim seeds fuse into ONE invocation, so 4 x cmb3sim + ViT + AFNO is SIX members in THREE invocations.
effect_zh: 不带 U-FNO 也能拿到 69 % 的跨家族收益。full split 的 sps：cmb3sim x3 44.31、ViT+AFNO+cmb3sim 44.68（+0.37）、U-FNO+ViT+AFNO 44.85（+0.54）、四家族全上 44.90（+0.59）；rel-L2 0.0762 → 0.0747 / 0.0744 / 0.0742，TKE 与 MVPE 同向。第 16 轮用 U-FNO x3 板上 −0.45 封了家族这条线，那对包成立（batch 1 下 time −0.207、rel_l2 +1.9 %），对成员不成立——它那 +0.44 sps 是有记录以来第三大的含盖率移动。四颗 cmb3sim 融合成一次调用，所以 4 x cmb3sim + ViT + AFNO 是六个成员、三次调用。
note: Latency is the whole risk: two extra invocations plus ~1.1 local ms is roughly 1.24 board ms = -0.087 final, which the accuracy has to clear first. AFNO2d and ViT2d are now vendored into _fno.py alongside UFNO2d and verify/diff_arch.py passes -- 0.000e+00 against the training definitions, each importable with models_alt BLOCKED, and the FNO path bit-identical after the edit.
note_zh: 延迟是全部风险：两次额外调用加约 1.1 本地 ms，大约是 1.24 board ms = −0.087 final，精度得先把这个赚回来。AFNO2d 与 ViT2d 现已与 UFNO2d 一同 vendor 进 _fno.py，verify/diff_arch.py 全过——对训练定义 0.000e+00、屏蔽 models_alt 后仍可导入、改动后 FNO 路径逐位不变。

arm: DINOv2 image-foundation-model trunk transplanted into ViT2d
arm_zh: 把 DINOv2 图像基础模型的主干移植进 ViT2d
instrument: dinov2_init.py -> train2.py --init. DINOv2-S/14 is dim 384 / depth 12 / 6 heads, which is ViT2d's dim and head count EXACTLY, so this is a pure INITIALIZATION A/B: same depth, width, parameter count, recipe, --seed, batch order and identical inference cost. Run at L8 (against r21c/1) and at L12 (against a matched random-init L12 control). The transplant verifies itself against a from-scratch reference DINOv2 block before writing -- 8.2e-6 / 2.1e-5 relative.
instrument_zh: dinov2_init.py → train2.py --init。DINOv2-S/14 是 dim 384 / depth 12 / 6 heads，正好就是 ViT2d 的 dim 和 head 数，所以这是纯初始化 A/B：同深度、同宽度、同参数量、同 recipe、同 --seed、同 batch 顺序、推理开销完全一致。在 L8（对 r21c/1）和 L12（对配对的随机初始化 L12 对照）各跑一次。移植在写盘前先对着从公式重写的参照块自检——相对误差 8.2e-6 / 2.1e-5。
effect: IT FITS BETTER AND GENERALIZES THE SAME. Training field loss is the LOWEST of the three arms at both depths -- L8 0.03794 against the random-init control's 0.04079, L12 0.03373 against 0.03582 -- and full-split sps is 50.99 (L8, +0.28 on a seed floor of 0.17 range / sigma 0.07 measured in r22g) and 50.59 (L12, -0.12, inside the floor). The sign does not survive the depth change. This is the signature of every capacity arm in this project, and the ViT capacity ladder itself (L8 -> L12 random: field 0.0408 -> 0.0358, sps 50.71 -> 50.72) reproduces it in the same job.
effect_zh: 拟合更好，泛化不变。两个深度上它的训练 field loss 都是三个臂里最低的——L8 0.03794 对随机初始化对照的 0.04079，L12 0.03373 对 0.03582——而 full-split sps 是 50.99（L8，+0.28，r22g 量出的种子噪声范围 0.17 / sigma 0.07）和 50.59（L12，−0.12，在噪声内）。符号扛不过深度改变。这是本项目每一个容量臂的签名，而 ViT 容量阶梯本身（L8 → L12 随机：field 0.0408 → 0.0358，sps 50.71 → 50.72）在同一个作业里复现了它。
note: DINOv3 is the same shape (dim 384 / depth 12) but gated behind an accepted Meta licence (HTTP 401) that sits badly with the requirement that winners open-source the solution; DINOv2 is Apache-2.0. Testing the MECHANISM on the free model first is what makes the DINOv3 question moot. Poseidon/scOT is reachable but CC-BY-NC-4.0 AND is a single-frame time-conditioned operator, i.e. 20 forward passes per window -- the latency shape round 4 rejected for DPOT.
note_zh: DINOv3 形状一样（dim 384 / depth 12），但被 Meta 自定义许可证挡住（HTTP 401），而且那个许可证与「获奖者必须开源方案」冲突；DINOv2 是 Apache-2.0。先在免费模型上验机制，正是让 DINOv3 这个问题变得无关紧要的原因。Poseidon/scOT 拿得到但是 CC-BY-NC-4.0，而且是单帧时间条件算子，每窗口 20 次前向——正是第 4 轮否掉 DPOT 的延迟形状。

arm: the asymmetric SPS interval -- must the band be CENTRED on the prediction?
arm_zh: 非对称 SPS 区间——band 一定要以预测为中心吗？
instrument: band_asym_v9.py: SPS charges exp(-(upper-lower)/sigma), so PLACEMENT is free and only WIDTH is paid. The optimum puts both endpoints on observed signed errors, so sweeping the count solves it exactly in O(n^2) with O(n) memory. The symmetric band is the constrained case, so in sample it CANNOT lose and grouped-trajectory CV is the whole question.
instrument_zh: band_asym_v9.py：SPS 收的是 exp(-(upper-lower)/sigma)，所以**位置免费、只有宽度付费**。最优解的两个端点都落在观测到的有符号误差上，于是扫计数就能在 O(n^2) 时间、O(n) 内存下精确求解。对称 band 是它的约束特例，样本内不可能输，所以按轨迹分组的 CV 就是全部问题。
effect: NULL, and it is the SEVENTH band closure. In sample +0.566 (all AoA) / +1.001 (AoA 15-20) as guaranteed; out of sample -0.294 sps, every one of five folds negative. The reason is in the data: the per-element MEDIAN SIGNED ERROR is only 0.093 of a half-width (quartiles 0.022 / 0.048 / 0.088), so there is no offset to exploit and fitting one spends 81,920 free numbers on ~300 windows. The interval stays centred on the prediction.
effect_zh: 空，而且是 band 的第七次关闭。样本内 +0.566（全 AoA）/ +1.001（AoA 15-20），如约；样本外 −0.294 sps，五折全负。原因在数据里：每元素的**中位有符号误差**只有半宽的 0.093（四分位 0.022 / 0.048 / 0.088），根本没有偏移可利用，硬拟合一个要拿 81,920 个自由数去对 ~300 个窗口。区间保持以预测为中心。

arm: fitted member weights for a HETEROGENEOUS ensemble
arm_zh: 异质集成的拟合成员权重
instrument: ens_stack_v9.py P1. predict_fno averages members with weight `n_members`, i.e. uniformly -- optimal for exchangeable seeds, and never previously worth fitting. A ViT next to three FNO seeds is not exchangeable: members differ in accuracy AND in error correlation. Field and sigma weights fitted separately over the simplex by projected gradient, grouped-trajectory CV, on seven held-out twins across four families.
instrument_zh: ens_stack_v9.py 的 P1。predict_fno 按 n_members 平均，也就是均匀——对可交换的 seed 是最优的，以前根本不值得拟合。但一个 ViT 挨着三个 FNO seed 并不可交换：成员在精度**和误差相关性**上都不同。field 与 sigma 权重在单纯形上分别用投影梯度拟合，按轨迹分组 CV，七个跨四个家族的留出孪生模型。
effect: CLEAN NULL, and it settles the question. Out-of-fold sps 45.76 against uniform's 45.75, and the fitted FIELD weights come out at 0.140-0.150 against 1/7 = 0.1429 -- uniform to within a percent. The sigma weights DO spread (0.070-0.249, the ViT and AFNO taking the most) and buy 0.0023 of TKE and +0.01 sps. Uniform averaging is optimal even when the members are NOT exchangeable.
effect_zh: 干净的空，而且把问题了结了。折外 sps 45.76 对均匀的 45.75，拟合出的 **field 权重是 0.140–0.150**，而 1/7 = 0.1429——差不到一个百分点。sigma 权重确实散开了（0.070–0.249，ViT 和 AFNO 拿得最多），但只换来 0.0023 的 TKE 和 +0.01 sps。**即使成员不可交换，均匀平均依然最优。**

arm: the SPS band scaled by CROSS-FAMILY spread, not just sigma_head
arm_zh: 用跨家族分歧而不只是 sigma_head 来缩放 SPS band
instrument: ens_stack_v9.py P2: half = base * (sigma/sigma_ref)^p * (spread/spread_ref)^q, so q = 0 reproduces the incumbent EXACTLY. `base` is refit inside every fold at every (p, q) by deflating the errors, since |E| <= base*r^k is |E|/r^k <= base -- fitting `base` once at q = 0 makes every q != 0 lose by construction, which is how round 6 closed the band wrongly and round 10 nearly repeated it.
instrument_zh: ens_stack_v9.py 的 P2：half = base * (sigma/sigma_ref)^p * (spread/spread_ref)^q，所以 q = 0 精确复现现役 band。每一折、每一个 (p, q) 都通过把误差除以 r^k 来重新拟合 `base`，因为 |E| <= base*r^k 等价于 |E|/r^k <= base——只在 q = 0 处拟合一次 `base`，会让每个 q != 0 按构造必输，第 6 轮正是这样把 band 错判成关闭的，第 10 轮差点重演。
effect: ROUND 6'S ORDERING REVERSES. corr(|E|, cross-family spread) after the per-element mean is removed is 0.571 against sigma_head's 0.537 -- round 6 read 0.347 / 0.551 on THREE WIDTH-24 SEEDS OF ONE RECIPE, where spread is seed noise. Across families it measures disagreement between inductive biases. Grouped-trajectory CV picks p 0.30 / q 0.30 for 45.950 against the incumbent's 45.747, +0.203 sps OUT OF SAMPLE; p 0.45 / q 0.15 gives +0.197, so it is a ridge and not a spike.
effect_zh: 第 6 轮的排序翻转了。去掉每元素均值后，corr(|E|, 跨家族 spread) = 0.571，而 sigma_head 是 0.537——第 6 轮在**一个 recipe 的三个 width-24 seed** 上读的是 0.347 / 0.551，那里的 spread 就是 seed 噪声。跨家族时它量的是不同归纳偏置之间的分歧。按轨迹分组 CV 选中 p 0.30 / q 0.30，45.950 对现役的 45.747，**样本外 +0.203 sps**；p 0.45 / q 0.15 给 +0.197，所以是一条脊而不是一个尖峰。
note: Not yet deployable as measured: spread was taken over seven individual members, but StackedFNO averages its fused members before predict_fno ever sees them, so per-member spread inside a fused group does not exist at inference. --spread-groups now computes it over GROUP means, which for the shipped xfam5 is the FNO group against the ViT -- exactly the two-object disagreement. Needs re-running in that configuration before it ships. The band is the largest historical mover of containment (+1.410) and it UNDER-read once already (round 10 predicted +0.95, delivered +1.393), and bounds feed no other subscore, so it is a one-sided bet.
note_zh: 按目前的测法还不能部署：spread 是在七个**单独**成员上取的，但 StackedFNO 在 predict_fno 看到之前就把融合成员平均掉了，融合组内部的 per-member spread 在推理时并不存在。--spread-groups 现在改成按**组均值**算，对已发货的 xfam5 就是 FNO 组对 ViT——正是那个两体分歧。上线前需要在这个配置下重跑。band 是历史上最大的含盖率推手（+1.410），而且**低报过一次**（第 10 轮预测 +0.95、实得 +1.393），bounds 又不喂任何别的子分数，是单边押注。

arm: does the shipped FNO recipe transfer to other architecture families?
arm_zh: 已发货的 FNO recipe 能迁移到别的架构家族吗？
instrument: r21c/r22a: ViT, AFNO and DilResNet retrained held-out with the full cmb3sim recipe (--sim --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full plus --lam-tgrad 0.3 --lam-v 0.15 --lam-cov 2.0 --cov-c 0.25) against their round-15 twins, then ens_v9 3-vs-3 with the band refit per set.
instrument_zh: r21c/r22a：ViT、AFNO、DilResNet 用完整 cmb3sim recipe 留出重训（--sim --lam-sim 0.3 --sim-loss full 加 --lam-tgrad 0.3 --lam-v 0.15 --lam-cov 2.0 --cov-c 0.25），对它们第 15 轮的孪生，再用 ens_v9 做 band 各自重拟合的 3-vs-3。
effect: IT TRANSFERS, AND IT IS SMALL. Per model, full-split sps: ViT 50.25 -> 50.71 (+0.46), AFNO 49.68 -> 49.99 (+0.31), DilResNet 49.95 -> 50.01 (+0.06). At ensemble size on cmb3sim x3: bare pair 44.73, cmb3sim-recipe pair 44.83 (+0.10). So sim and the wave-1 winners are not FNO-specific -- consistent with sim being a STRUCTURED PERTURBATION rather than data -- but the ensemble keeps only a fifth of the per-model gain.
effect_zh: 能迁移，而且很小。per model 的 full-split sps：ViT 50.25 → 50.71（+0.46）、AFNO 49.68 → 49.99（+0.31）、DilResNet 49.95 → 50.01（+0.06）。在 cmb3sim x3 上的集成规模：裸 recipe 一对 44.73，cmb3sim recipe 一对 44.83（+0.10）。所以 sim 和 wave-1 赢家不是 FNO 专有的——这与「sim 是结构化扰动而非数据」一致——但集成只留下 per-model 收益的五分之一。
note: The package that shipped as R21/T2R9 contains arch_vit_all_s1.pth, whose stored config reads lam_cov 0.0 / lam_tgrad 0.0 / lam_v 0.3 -- the round-15 BARE recipe. So the board result was obtained with the STALE member and this +0.10 is still on the table.
note_zh: 作为 R21/T2R9 发货的包里装的是 arch_vit_all_s1.pth，它存下来的 config 是 lam_cov 0.0 / lam_tgrad 0.0 / lam_v 0.3——第 15 轮的**裸** recipe。所以板上那个结果是用**过期成员**拿到的，这 +0.10 还在桌上。

arm: THE INVOCATION COEFFICIENT, measured on the board instead of fitted
arm_zh: 板上直接量 invocation 的系数，不再拟合
instrument: a submission slot on BOTH tracks the same day: round 20's own checkpoints, own fp16 packing and own band bytes, FUSE=False the only change (1 fused invocation -> 4 sequential forwards). Gated before upload by verify/pkg_identity.py against the archives actually uploaded in round 20 (4.66e-06 / 4.27e-06) and by reading FUSE=False back out of both zips
instrument_zh: 同一天在两个赛道各用掉一个提交名额：R20 自己的 checkpoint、自己的 fp16 打包、自己的 band 字节，只改 FUSE=False（一次融合调用变四次顺序前向）。上传前用 pkg_identity 对着 R20 真正上传的压缩包验到 4.66e-06 / 4.27e-06，并从两个 zip 里读回 FUSE=False
effect: 1.151 ms per invocation on Track 1 and 0.866 on Track 2, against a fitted 0.435 -- the model was 2.65x / 1.99x LIGHT. The gate held perfectly: rel/tke/mvpe came back identical to six decimals on both boards and sps moved 2e-05, so the whole -0.225 / -0.160 is `time`. Priced through w_time, the FIRST extra invocation is -0.085 final (T1) / -0.058 (T2). TWO FREE RESULTS: (a) Track 2 is CHEAPER per invocation, its +0.86 ms handicap is a fixed per-step cost -- at 4 invocations the boards meet at 7.249 vs 7.255, so round 22's '2.4x heavier on Track 2' is withdrawn; (b) the board is LAUNCH-bound, not FLOP-bound -- 4 sequential forwards do the same FLOPs as 1 grouped one, so everything the board charges for here is dispatch
effect_zh: Track 1 每次调用 1.151 毫秒，Track 2 是 0.866，而拟合值只有 0.435——模型轻了 2.65 倍 / 1.99 倍。闸门守得很干净：两个板上 rel/tke/mvpe 都精确到小数点后六位相同，sps 只动了 2e-05，所以 -0.225 / -0.160 全是 time。按 w_time 折算，第一次多出来的调用值 -0.085 final（T1）/ -0.058（T2）。另外白捡两个结论：(a) Track 2 每次调用反而更便宜，它那 +0.86 毫秒是固定的每步开销——到四次调用时两个板在 7.249 和 7.255 汇合，所以第 22 轮说的「Track 2 的调用税重 2.4 倍」撤回；(b) 板上是受 kernel launch 限制而不是受 FLOPs 限制——四次顺序前向和一次 grouped 前向的 FLOPs 相同，所以这里板上收的全是 dispatch 的钱
verdict: MEASURED -- the invocation is expensive, and it is the reason to fuse
note: Consequences, in order of size. (1) A second architecture family must now earn back -0.085 / -0.058; R21's ViT earned +0.148 / +0.152 of accuracy, so it clears -- but barely enough that a THIRD family is out of the question. (2) StackedViT is worth building: a second ViT inside the existing group adds FLOPs, not calls. (3) Never predict a board LEVEL from the latency model -- its residuals reach -2.5 ms and are ordered by date. Anchor and take deltas.. CORRECTED IN ROUND 24: '(b) the board is LAUNCH-bound, not FLOP-bound' was half wrong -- launches are expensive AND FLOPs are charged, ~1.75 board ms per 4060-equivalent local ms on Track 1
note_zh: 按重要性排的后果。(1) 第二个架构族现在必须挣回 -0.085 / -0.058；R21 的 ViT 挣了 +0.148 / +0.152 的精度，所以过关——但余量小到第三个族根本不用考虑。(2) StackedViT 值得做：在现有组里再加一个 ViT 只加 FLOPs，不加调用。(3) 永远不要用延迟模型预测板上的绝对值——它的残差能到 -2.5 毫秒而且按日期排序。锚定一轮，只取差值。。第 24 轮更正：'(b) 板上受 launch 限制而不受 FLOPs 限制' 只对了一半——launch 贵，FLOPs 也收钱，Track 1 上约每 4060 等效本地毫秒 1.75 板上毫秒

arm: int8 packing, SCORED for the first time: does it cost sps, on FNO and on the ViT?
arm_zh: int8 打包第一次按分数而非场误差计价：FNO 和 ViT 各掉多少 sps？
instrument: quant8.py --score: every packing scheme through the official scorer with the package's OWN band held fixed, 336 val_unseen windows; the 'shipped packer' rows go through _fno.pack_state_dict -> load_any -> dequant8, the exact archive path. Run on cmb3sim x3 (R20's band), on R21's own twin set (R21's band), on the xfam5v2s1 set, and on the ViT alone
instrument_zh: quant8.py --score：每种打包方式都用该包自己的 band 固定打分，336 个 val_unseen 窗口；'shipped packer' 这几行走 _fno.pack_state_dict -> load_any -> dequant8，与压缩包完全同一路径。分别在 cmb3sim x3（R20 的 band）、R21 自己的孪生集（R21 的 band）、xfam5v2s1 集和单独的 ViT 上跑
effect: FREE, everywhere it is actually used. FNO per-(out,in) d sps -0.003 (cmb3sim x3), every error identical to 4 decimals; fp16 0.000. Coarser schemes are NOT free: per-tensor -0.59, per-mode -0.59, per-out-channel -0.08. FOUND ON THE WAY: for a 2-D Linear the per-(out,in) rule reduces over an EMPTY range and torch.amax(dim=()) reduces over ALL dims, so every ViT Linear got ONE scale -- and R21 / T2R9 shipped that. Scored, it costs NOTHING: R21's own set -0.001, xfam5v2s1's -0.000, the ViT alone -0.004 (per-row -0.009, fp16 +0.001). quant8's own 'per tensor' row reads -0.71 on the ViT alone because it also quantizes embed/pos/grid/heads per tensor; the Linears tolerate it
effect_zh: 在实际用到的地方全部免费。FNO 按 (out,in) d sps -0.003，所有误差到小数点后 4 位不变；fp16 0.000。更粗的粒度不免费：逐张量 -0.59、逐模态 -0.59、逐输出通道 -0.08。顺带发现：二维 Linear 上 (out,in) 规则的归约范围为空，而 torch.amax(dim=()) 会归约所有维度，于是每个 ViT Linear 只有一个缩放系数——R21 / T2R9 就是这样上板的。按分数算它不花钱：R21 自己的集合 -0.001，xfam5v2s1 -0.000，单独 ViT -0.004（逐行 -0.009，fp16 +0.001）。quant8 自己的 'per tensor' 行在单独 ViT 上是 -0.71，是因为它把 embed/pos/grid/头部也逐张量量化了；Linear 本身扛得住
verdict: CLOSED -- int8 is free for every member family we ship; the Linear scale is a code defect with zero score cost
note: Two consequences. (1) The member-count line is unblocked: eight w96 L8 FNOs plus a ViT fit at 247 MB. (2) A defect that the field-perturbation table could not see was found only by scoring the REAL code path; quant8's re-implementation of the quantizer agreed with the packer on every tensor shape except the one that mattered
note_zh: 两个后果。(1) 成员数这条线解锁了：八个 w96 L8 FNO 加一个 ViT 共 247 MB。(2) 场扰动表看不见的缺陷，只有给真实代码路径打分才找得到；quant8 自己重写的量化器除了关键的那种张量形状，与打包器处处一致

arm: StackedViT: K ViT members in one invocation -- exact, and does Track 2 keep its CUDA graph?
arm_zh: StackedViT：K 个 ViT 合成一次调用——是否精确，Track 2 的 CUDA graph 是否保得住？
instrument: verify/fuse_vit.py (synthetic random members, real checkpoints, mixed FNO+ViT) with TF32 off; then R21-as-uploaded, the repaired xfam5 and the 2-ViT xfam6 loaded side by side in ONE process on ONE node: Track 2 get_ttt_model -> ttt_step at batch 1 (graph status read off the model), Track 1 predict() over 336 windows
instrument_zh: verify/fuse_vit.py（合成随机成员、真实 checkpoint、FNO+ViT 混合），TF32 关闭；然后把 R21 原包、修复后的 xfam5、两个 ViT 的 xfam6 在同一节点的同一进程里并排加载：Track 2 走 get_ttt_model -> ttt_step，batch 1（从模型上读 graph 状态），Track 1 对 336 个窗口跑 predict()
effect: EXACT and GRAPHED. Synthetic field 1.5e-08, real checkpoints 3.4e-06 at alpha 0.90, sigma 1.2e-08; 2 FNO + 3 ViT -> exactly 2 invocations [StackedFNO, StackedViT]. Track 2 keeps the CUDA graph for all three packages (the graph is dropped on ANY eager/replay disagreement, and it was not). A second fused ViT costs +1.37 ms/step at batch 1 (3.418 -> 4.788) and +0.32 ms/window on Track 1 (1.496 -> 1.812) -- pure FLOPs, no launches. An earlier 3.87 -> 7.34 reading came from two separate build runs and was noise
effect_zh: 精确，且保住了 graph。合成场 1.5e-08，真实 checkpoint 在 alpha 0.90 下 3.4e-06，sigma 1.2e-08；2 FNO + 3 ViT 正好 2 次调用 [StackedFNO, StackedViT]。三个包在 Track 2 上都保住了 CUDA graph（eager 与 replay 只要有任何不一致就会丢 graph，这里没有丢）。第二个融合的 ViT 在 batch 1 下每步 +1.37 ms（3.418 -> 4.788），Track 1 上每窗口 +0.32 ms（1.496 -> 1.812）——纯 FLOPs，不增加 launch。之前那个 3.87 -> 7.34 的读数来自两次不同的构建，是噪声
verdict: BUILT AND GATED -- a second ViT is free in invocations
note: Timings are only comparable inside one process on one node: the same package read 3.87 ms/step in one build job and 3.37 in another
note_zh: 计时只在同一节点同一进程内可比：同一个包在一次构建里读 3.87 ms/step，另一次读 3.37

arm: the MARGINAL ViT curve at ensemble size: does a second and third ViT keep paying?
arm_zh: 集成规模下的边际 ViT 曲线：第二、第三个 ViT 还值钱吗？
instrument: ens_v9.py, band refit per set, all members held out: cmb3sim FNO x3 plus 1 / 2 / 3 ViTs, at the round-15 BARE recipe (r24d) and at the cmb3sim recipe (r24e, after r24c trained two more ViT twins), AoA 15-20 proxy and full split
instrument_zh: ens_v9.py，每个集合各自重拟合 band，全部成员留出：cmb3sim FNO x3 加 1 / 2 / 3 个 ViT，分别用第 15 轮的裸配方（r24d）和 cmb3sim 配方（r24e，r24c 又训练了两个 ViT 孪生之后），AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分
effect: It SATURATES AT TWO, on both recipes. Full-split sps, cmb3sim recipe: +0.48 / +0.15 / +0.07 for the 1st / 2nd / 3rd ViT (proxy +0.56 / +0.20 / +0.08); bare recipe +0.39 / +0.14 / +0.00. TKE falls with every ViT (0.4995 -> 0.4925 -> 0.4893 -> 0.4865), and three ViTs ALONE have the lowest TKE of any set (0.4869) -- the family carries TKE. The cmb3sim ViT beats the bare one as a first member by +0.09, as r21c said
effect_zh: 两种配方下都在第二个就饱和。cmb3sim 配方全划分 sps：第 1 / 2 / 3 个 ViT 分别 +0.48 / +0.15 / +0.07（代理集 +0.56 / +0.20 / +0.08）；裸配方 +0.39 / +0.14 / +0.00。TKE 随每个 ViT 下降（0.4995 -> 0.4925 -> 0.4893 -> 0.4865），而三个 ViT 单独组成的集合 TKE 最低（0.4869）——这个家族扛着 TKE。cmb3sim ViT 作为第一个成员比裸配方好 +0.09，与 r21c 一致
verdict: SHIPPED AS xfam6 (R24): the accuracy transferred, the FLOPs cost more than it
note: Priced on the board as xfam6: R21's uploaded archive plus one cmb3sim ViT inside the ViT group. BOARD (R24, 2026-09-12): accuracy +0.050 -- containment +0.053, a third of the first ViT's, as this curve said -- but +1.02 board ms of FLOPs cost -0.069, net -0.019 vs R21. The second ViT is worth having only if its compute gets cheaper
note_zh: 在板上以 xfam6 定价：R21 已上传的压缩包，外加一个 cmb3sim ViT 放进 ViT 组。板上（R24，2026-09-12）：精度 +0.050——含盖率 +0.053，是第一个 ViT 的三分之一，与这条曲线一致——但 FLOPs 多出的 +1.02 板上毫秒花掉 -0.069，相对 R21 净值 -0.019。第二个 ViT 只有在算力变便宜后才值得

arm: member count 4 -> 8 at w96 L8, WITH the ViT in the set: can it be priced locally at all?
arm_zh: w96 L8 下成员数 4 -> 8（集合里已有 ViT）：本地到底能不能定价？
instrument: ens_v9.py over every subset of the three held-out cmb3sim FNO twins, alone and with R21's ViT twin, band refit per set, AoA 15-20 proxy and full split; e(K) = e_inf + c/K fitted on K = 1..3 and the ratio e(8)/e(4) applied to T2R9's BOARD errors, so the board supplies the level and the curve only the shape
instrument_zh: ens_v9.py 遍历三个留出 cmb3sim FNO 孪生的所有子集，单独以及加上 R21 的 ViT 孪生，每个集合各自重拟合 band，AoA 15-20 代理集与全划分；在 K = 1..3 上拟合 e(K) = e_inf + c/K，把 e(8)/e(4) 的比值作用到 T2R9 的板上误差，水平来自板，曲线只给形状
effect: A LOCAL NULL ONCE THE FAMILY IS MIXED. FNO only: full-split sps K=1/2/3 43.86 / 44.19 / 44.31, fitted 4->8 sps +0.084 (proxy +0.090), rel x0.996. With R21's ViT: 44.56 / 44.68 / 44.70, 4->8 sps +0.027 (proxy +0.022), rel x0.9985, tke x1.0009 (slightly WORSE), mvpe x0.998. Priced against T2R9: 81.154 estimate of record, floor 81.115, optimistic 81.166. The ViT supplies the diversity that more FNO seeds would; the two levers overlap
effect_zh: 家族混合后本地是空值。只有 FNO：全划分 sps K=1/2/3 为 43.86 / 44.19 / 44.31，拟合出 4->8 sps +0.084（代理集 +0.090），rel x0.996。加上 R21 的 ViT：44.56 / 44.68 / 44.70，4->8 sps +0.027（代理集 +0.022），rel x0.9985，tke x1.0009（略差），mvpe x0.998。对 T2R9 定价：记录值 81.154，下限 81.115，乐观端 81.166。ViT 已经提供了更多 FNO 种子本可带来的多样性；两个杠杆互相重叠
verdict: CLOSED ON THE BOARD (T2R11): accuracy -0.020, the local null was right
note: x8v is R21's archive with fno.pth-fno_5.pth AND the band byte-identical, plus FNO s5-s8: 247.4 MB of 256, [StackedFNO(8), ViT2d(1)], Track-2 graph active, +1.234 ms/step at batch 1. sps >= ~41.75 on the board means member count still moves containment at w96 L8 and the local curve is blind to it; within +-0.05 of 41.649 closes it. BOARD (T2R11, 2026-09-12): rel -0.09 %, tke +0.44 % and mvpe +1.64 % WORSE, containment +0.023 -- a null, as the K-curve said -- plus +1.37 board ms of FLOPs, net -0.097
note_zh: x8v 就是 R21 的压缩包，fno.pth-fno_5.pth 和 band 都逐字节相同，再加 FNO s5-s8：256 MB 中占 247.4 MB，[StackedFNO(8), ViT2d(1)]，Track 2 graph 保持激活，batch 1 下每步 +1.234 ms。板上 sps >= ~41.75 说明成员数在 w96 L8 下仍然推动含盖率而本地曲线看不见；落在 41.649 的 ±0.05 以内则关闭这条线。板上（T2R11，2026-09-12）：rel -0.09 %，tke +0.44 %、mvpe +1.64 % 变差，含盖率 +0.023——与 K 曲线一样是空值——另加 FLOPs 的 +1.37 板上毫秒，净值 -0.097

arm: FAST NUMERICS as a latency lever now that the board charges FLOPs: fp16 autocast, bf16, TF32 -- accuracy cost and permutation invariance
arm_zh: 板上既然按 FLOPs 收钱，快速数值能否成为延迟杠杆：fp16 autocast、bf16、TF32——精度代价与排列不变性
instrument: each mode in a FRESH process (the switches are read at import) on R21's and R24's uploaded Track-1 archives: predict() over the 336 val_unseen windows, the four error metrics through the scorer, rel-L2 of the prediction against the fp32 run, and predict() on a permuted window order compared element-wise; Track 2 streamed through validate_t2 plus graph status and step time
instrument_zh: 每种模式单独起一个进程（开关在 import 时读取），用 R21 和 R24 已上传的 Track 1 压缩包：对 336 个 val_unseen 窗口 predict()，四个误差指标过打分器，预测与 fp32 结果比 rel-L2，再把窗口顺序打乱逐元素比对；Track 2 走 validate_t2，并读 graph 状态与每步时间
effect: fp16 and TF32 are SAFE; bf16 CRASHES. Track 1 fp16: every error metric identical to 4-5 decimals (R21 sps 59.371 -> 59.371, R24 59.539 -> 59.539), prediction moved 6.0e-4 / 6.3e-4 relative, PERMUTATION INVARIANCE EXACT (0.0). TF32: identical metrics, 9.0e-5 / 5.4e-5, permutation exact -- the batch-position hazard that disabled it does not show at these shapes. bf16: RuntimeError in the spectral path's torch.complex (no BFloat16 support). Local A100 time is noise-dominated across processes (R21 fp16 -19 %, R24 fp16 -3 %). Track 2: errors identical under fp16, graph ACTIVE; step time package-dependent (R21 +23 % slower, R24 -32 % faster, separate processes)
effect_zh: fp16 与 TF32 安全；bf16 崩溃。Track 1 fp16：所有误差指标到小数点后 4-5 位不变（R21 sps 59.371 -> 59.371，R24 59.539 -> 59.539），预测相对变化 6.0e-4 / 6.3e-4，排列不变性精确为 0。TF32：指标不变，9.0e-5 / 5.4e-5，排列精确——当初关掉它的 batch 位置问题在这些形状下不出现。bf16：频谱路径里的 torch.complex 不支持 BFloat16，报 RuntimeError。本地 A100 时间跨进程噪声主导（R21 fp16 -19 %，R24 fp16 -3 %）。Track 2：fp16 下误差不变，graph 激活；每步时间视包而定（R21 慢 23 %，R24 快 32 %，分属不同进程）
verdict: SHIPPED -- fp16 ran on both boards (R25 / T2R12); TF32 is equally safe and not yet baked
note: fp16 raises 'ComplexHalf support is experimental' from _fno.py's spectral product; it computes correctly on the A100, but an unknown board GPU is exactly where an experimental kernel fails, so a shipped fp16 path must verify itself against fp32 at load time and fall back. BOARD (R25 / T2R12, read 2026-09-14): the fingerprint says fp16 RAN (error subscores moved <= 3e-4 against R24). Track 1 realised 37 % of the local -21 % (5.570 -> 5.076 board ms, +0.033 final, new best); on Track 2 fp16 recovered ~20 % and did not pay for the second ViT (time 91.04 < 91.52). TF32 is the next precision lever, and it has to be baked like AMP before the board can read it
note_zh: fp16 会在 _fno.py 的频谱乘积处报 'ComplexHalf support is experimental'；A100 上算得对，但未知的板上 GPU 正是实验性 kernel 会出问题的地方，所以上线的 fp16 路径必须在加载时自检对照 fp32，不一致就回退。板上（R25 / T2R12，2026-09-14 读取）：指纹显示 fp16 确实跑了（误差子分数相对 R24 只动 ≤ 3e-4）。Track 1 兑现了本地 -21 % 的 37 %（5.570 -> 5.076 板上毫秒，final +0.033，新最佳）；Track 2 上 fp16 只省回约 20 %，抵不上第二个 ViT（time 91.04 < 91.52）。下一个精度杠杆是 TF32，要像 AMP 一样烤进包里，板上才能读

arm: fp16 autocast BAKED into R24's archive (xfam6fp16): does the shipped path run fp16, keep fp32's scores, and cut compute?
arm_zh: 把 fp16 autocast 烤进 R24 的压缩包（xfam6fp16）：上线路径真的跑 fp16 吗，分数和 fp32 一样吗，算力省了多少？
instrument: build_round13.sh with RPDE_SHIP_AMP='"fp16"' on R24's exact members, band and packing; verify/pkg_identity.py on an AMP=None twin against R24 as uploaded (Track 1) and xfam6's pre-change Track-2 build; verify/amp_path.py -- AMP_ACTIVE, the four error metrics against an fp32 twin of the SAME archive through the scorer, permutation invariance, and fp32/fp16 timed interleaved in ONE process
instrument_zh: build_round13.sh 加 RPDE_SHIP_AMP='"fp16"'，成员、band、打包都与 R24 完全相同；pkg_identity 把 AMP=None 的孪生包与 R24 已上传的包（Track 1）和改代码前的 xfam6 Track 2 包对比；verify/amp_path.py——AMP_ACTIVE、同一压缩包的 fp32 孪生过打分器比四个误差指标、排列不变性，以及 fp32/fp16 在同一进程里交替计时
effect: PASS, and the cut is large. The DEFAULT path is bit-identical to what is on the board (0.000e+00 on both tracks) after pinning `_spec_bmm`'s real matmul to fp32 -- autocast had been running it in fp16 and building an experimental ComplexHalf tensor. AMP_ACTIVE float16 on both tracks (probe diff 6.5e-4 / 9.4e-4 against a 2e-2 fallback threshold), Track-2 CUDA graph kept. Track 1 against its fp32 twin: rel 0.05156 / 0.05155, tke 0.28506 / 0.28507, mvpe 0.03806, sps 59.539 both; prediction 6.3e-4; permutation exact. Track 2 ttt_step 8.4e-4. Interleaved, one process: Track 1 1.918 -> 1.510 ms/window (-21.3 %), Track 2 7.022 -> 3.768 ms/step (-46.3 %)
effect_zh: 通过，而且省得多。把 `_spec_bmm` 的实数矩阵乘固定为 fp32 之后（autocast 原先把它跑成 fp16 并构造实验性的 ComplexHalf 张量），默认路径与板上的包逐位相同（两个赛道都是 0.000e+00）。两个赛道 AMP_ACTIVE 都是 float16（探针差 6.5e-4 / 9.4e-4，回退阈值 2e-2），Track 2 的 CUDA graph 保留。Track 1 对 fp32 孪生：rel 0.05156 / 0.05155，tke 0.28506 / 0.28507，mvpe 0.03806，sps 都是 59.539；预测相差 6.3e-4；排列精确。Track 2 ttt_step 8.4e-4。同一进程交替计时：Track 1 1.918 -> 1.510 ms/window（-21.3 %），Track 2 7.022 -> 3.768 ms/step（-46.3 %）
verdict: SHIPPED AS xfam6fp16 (R25 / T2R12): fp16 ran on the board; Track 1 realised 37 % of the local cut (+0.033, new best); on Track 2 it did not recover the second ViT's FLOPs
note: The board is the only instrument that prices this: the -21 % is the A100's tensor cores, and how much of it an unknown board GPU realises is exactly what the slot reads. The four error subscores must come back at R24's values; if one moves, the A/B is void. BOARD (read 2026-09-14): R25's errors moved -0.000037 / +0.000276 / -0.000260 and sps +0.001013 against R24 -- the fingerprint that fp16 ran, so the A/B is valid; board ms 5.570 -> 5.076 is 37 % of the -1.321 that full transfer at 1.75 board ms per 4060-eq ms would give (15-60 % across drift); final 81.344644 against an estimate of 81.356. T2R12's errors landed within 0.017 of the cross-track prediction with containment +0.041, but time 91.040 (7.061 ms) < 91.52; final 81.164374 against 81.223
note_zh: 只有板上能给它定价：-21 % 是 A100 张量核心的数字，未知的板上 GPU 能兑现多少，正是这个名额要读的。四个误差子分数必须回到 R24 的值；动了一个，这个 A/B 就作废。板上（2026-09-14 读取）：R25 的误差相对 R24 动了 -0.000037 / +0.000276 / -0.000260，sps +0.001013——这就是 fp16 跑了的指纹，A/B 有效；板上 5.570 -> 5.076 ms，是按每 4060 等效毫秒 1.75 板上毫秒全额兑现（-1.321）的 37 %（算上漂移为 15-60 %）；final 81.344644，预测 81.356。T2R12 的误差与跨赛道预测相差不超过 0.017，含盖率 +0.041，但 time 91.040（7.061 ms）< 91.52；final 81.164374，预测 81.223
